As an Australian-born brand rooted in innovation and inclusivity, we are proud to champio n a new wave of desserts that prioritise not only taste but also the health of our communities. The recommended shelf life is 6 months from the date of packing, however, this can be extended with proper storage. For best results, store matcha in an airtight container, away from heat, light, moisture, and strong odours. To preserve flavour, aroma, colour, and nutritional integrity, all matcha is stored at -20°C from the time of first harvest until it is packed for shipping. This ultra-low temperature storage helps maintain the freshness and quality of the tea right up until it reaches you. Storing Matcha Matcha is delicate. Its vibrant color, fresh aroma, and smooth flavor can quickly fade if not stored correctly. A few simple habits will keep your matcha at its best. Use an Airtight Container: Exposure to air is one of matcha’s biggest enemies. Always transfer your matcha into a clean, airtight container as soon as possible. This helps preserve its flavor, color, and nutritional quality by protecting it from oxidation. Store It in the Freezer: To keep your matcha fresh for longer, store it in the freezer. The cold temperature slows down the natural processes that cause matcha to lose its flavor, aroma, and bright green color. Freezing helps because: Cold slows chemical reactions, so oxidation happens much more slowly. Flavor and aroma are preserved longer, especially those fresh, grassy notes. Color stays vibrant due to less degradation of chlorophyll. Unlike many foods, matcha freezes exceptionally well because it is completely dry. There is no water inside the powder to form ice crystals, so its texture remains unchanged. As long as moisture is kept out, the matcha will stay fine, smooth, and easy to sift. When using frozen matcha, allow the container to come to room temperature before opening. This prevents condensation from forming, which can introduce moisture and cause clumping. A small note: Matcha is best enjoyed fresh. Proper storage simply helps preserve its quality, so every cup tastes as it should. Clayton campus Clayton campus is the largest of all eight Monash University campuses. It is located 20km south-east of Melbourne. Caulfield campus Caulfield campus is Monash University's second largest campus, nine kilometres south-east of Melbourne. Peninsula campus Peninsula campus is Monash University's third largest campus. Parkville campus The Parkville campus has recently undergone a $50 million redevelopment, which includes new world-class research laboratories and teaching space. Alfred campus Our Alfred campus provides health and medical research and education. It is home to our Sub Faculty of Translational Medicine and Public Health and is co-located at Alfred Health in Melbourne. Law Chambers Located in the heart of the Melbourne's legal precinct and within walking distance of the Magistrates, County and Supreme Courts. 750 Collins Street A welcoming and vibrant vertical village with innovative and modern amenities in the heart of Melbourne. Jakarta campus, Indonesia Our Indonesia campus is situated in Tangerang Regency, Banten, southwest of Jakarta – part of a burgeoning, modern and sustainable location. Prato campus, Italy The Prato campus offers global education programs, international research collaboration, professional development courses, school tours, and creative residencies, all designed to foster intellectual and cultural exchange in a European setting. Southeast University – Monash University Joint Graduate School, China Monash University has partnered with Southeast University (SEU) to create a Joint Graduate School and a Joint Research Institute in Suzhou. Our commitment to Indigenous Peoples Our work in equity, diversity and inclusion is about moving forward and progressing together as a University and a community. But to move forward, it's imperative to first recognise the past, present and ongoing legacy of colonisation in Australia, and to be cognisant of the unlearning that is required in the decolonial process. We must actively listen and learn from Indigenous voices, be guided by the principles of Aboriginal self-determination and acknowledge the unique position First Nations Peoples hold in the decision-making and future of their unceded lands and waters. PUBLIC NOTICES VISUAL ARCHIVES SIT CULINARY DOCUMENT REFRESHMENT DOCUMENT SIT №001 sit Suite 2/387 Illawarra Road - Marrickville ‘SIT’ is a cafe from Baba’s Place Pty Ltd. It was built in collaboration with Fresh Hope Communities, a NFP organisation, and it is located at the ground floor of a Nightingale affordable housing precinct in Marrickville. So what is SIT? It is a cafe focusing on sustainable, seasonal and thoughtful offerings with a multi-functional space committed to fostering community and knowledge sharing. SIT is a soft, but firm command to become sedentary. Why? Because sitting & sharing moments is pivotal to a version of suburban, communal life we’d like to romanticize AND practically apply. From the start, SIT will provide an exemplary F&B service to consumers AND offer itself as a place in which collaboration, ideas & community can grow. How will we show this? How will this be made clear to those who are interested? Sustainable kitchen practices, human lead interior design/brand communication, a commitment to Social Enterprise goals, and a committed and passionate team. Skip to Content Gallery Catering Contact Menu Order Online Reservations Reborn Specialty Coffee EST. 2022 Welcome to Reborn Café, your neighbourhood Vietnamese-inspired café in Sydney. With locations in Burwood and Marrickville, we’re serving specialty coffee, all-day brunch, and fresh Vietnamese flavours that set us apart. From Vietnamese iced coffee to bánh mì and brunch classics with a twist, Reborn is where locals come to eat, sip, and stay a while. About Us Reborn Café began with a love of coffee and community. Our founders grew up in Vietnam, where coffee isn’t just a drink, but a daily ritual and a way of bringing people together. When they moved to Sydney, they carried that passion with them, along with the bold flavours and vibrant culture they knew so well. What started as a local café has evolved into a Vietnamese-inspired dining experience, blending tradition with the relaxed Sydney brunch scene. From Vietnamese coffee to a bánh mì served fresh with herbs, every detail reflects both our heritage and our home here in Sydney. Each location has its own personality, but both Burwood and Marrickville share the same heart: authentic flavours, genuine hospitality, and a space that feels like home. Come check out Tokyo Lamington & the Bakery in Marrickville Frequently Asked Questions FAQ Which country invented lamingtons Australia invented the lamington. While there's some friendly rivalry with New Zealand over various food origins, the lamington is widely acknowledged as an Australian creation. What makes a lamington a lamington? Three essential elements define a lamington: sponge cake, chocolate coating, and a layer of desiccated coconut. This combination of textures and flavours - the soft cake, smooth chocolate, and crispy coconut - is what makes a lamington a lamington. We at Tokyo Lamington pushes the boundaries of a lamington with our creations. Is there egg in your lamington? Yes, our lamingtons contain cooked pasteurised eggs as they provide structure and lightness to our sponge cake. Saying that, our vegan lamington is egg-free. Is there gelatin in your lamington? Some of our lamington contains halal gelatin in the cream, with the exception of our vegan lamington. How long can you keep lamingtons? Our lamingtons are made with fresh ingredients, they can be kept refrigerated for up to 2 days, of course the sooner you eat them the better. A short, devout letter about flour, water, salt, the people who made it, and what happens when you pay attention. — HOW IT STARTED — One oven, one park, one stubborn idea. Chandni and Ankit, wife and husband, were eating Neapolitan pizza in Italy when the bread did something they hadn't felt before: light, airy, satisfying without the bloat. They came home wanting to taste it again. Ankit spent over a thousand hours on fermentation, through videos, blogs, hosted lunches and dinners for friends, until the dough behaved. Then they took a second-hand oven down to Pirrama Park and gave the sandwiches away to find out if anyone else loved them. They did. A twelve-week pop-up out of Lucky Pickle followed. Chandni left her tech career. Pyrmont opened. Marrickville followed. The leap kept landing. — THE DOUGH — Patience you can't fake. Everything starts with our dough: slow-fermented, cared for over days, and shaped with the kind of patience you can't fake. That time and technique guide every decision we make in our kitchen. Light on your gut. Big on flavour. The bread tells you it's working before we do. — THE BENCH — Simple, every day, made in-house. We make most things ourselves, from sauces, marinades, dressings, rubs and curry pastes, because letting real ingredients shine is the only way we know how to cook. We don't rely on heavy sauces or shortcuts. We lean on good olive oil, salt, pepper, and fire. We grill, char, slow-cook and roast. We don't fry. Smoke, heat and honest ingredients do the flavouring naturally. — THE FRIENDS — Good humans making good products. For the few things we don't specialise in, we choose partners who care as deeply as we do. Five Senses for coffee. Pepe Saya for butter. Vannella for stracciatella. LP's Quality Meats for mortadella. Gelato Messina for sweet things. Somage for matcha and chai. Single-origin where it matters. First names, where possible. Things we won't compromise on. — WHAT WE BELIEVE — Three rules, kept honest. Ingredients we'd eat at home.If we wouldn't serve it to family, we don't serve it to you. Nothing fried, no shortcuts, no artificial fillers. Customer at the centre. Every menu item, every ingredient choice, every detail of the room came from listening to the people who walk in. Always growing.We started as a pop-up. We've never stopped behaving like one: refining recipes, sharpening process, opening doors we hadn't imagined. — 2023 — The Italy trip An aha-moment in Naples. Our Story Firestone Sydney Firestone Sydney has been part of the local community for 14 years, built on a simple belief. A good cup of coffee can change the course of your day. From the first pour in the morning to the last sip in the afternoon, we focus on serving coffee that feels honest, comforting and carefully made. For over 14 years, our baristas have worked with quality beans and thoughtful techniques to bring out the best flavour in every cup. REQUEST HIGH TEA HOME ORDER FOR PICKUP GET IT DELIVERED HIGH TEA VENUE HIRE CATERING GIFT CARDS REVIEWS MORE WHAT'S ON CONTACT ABOUT OUR STORY FAQS Our Story We are a small family with 2 young kids. We migrated from UK to Australia and have called Sydney our home ever since. We have been welcomed with open arms by the community and believe we are in one of the best countries in the world! Having worked in the corporate world for a long time, the pandemic proved to be a pivotal moment as it allowed us time to reflect on the purpose of life, what we enjoy doing and how best we could serve the community. Being passionate about food, entertainment, helping others and having a corporate background made us believe that the hospitality industry is worth a shot, and we have not looked back since! EXPLORE NOW Our Venue We are big nature lovers and strongly believe being closer to nature is the way to attain Nirvana! Nature has been our inspiration for the café theme, and it is reflected in the rustic farmhouse vibe we have created for the café’. Everything else is aligned with it – the colorful floral ambiance, the music, the simplicity and freshness in our food, the diversity of our offerings & our focus on sustainability through reuse of recycled building materials. Our USP is undoubtedly the overall experience that we provide our customers when they visit us. It starts with a friendly service having a high level of empathy for our customers. Next is our food which is visually appealing yet healthy, fresh and flavourful. It this combination which really helps us stand out as most other venues struggle to get a tick in all the boxes. Our menu is diverse with over 30 items across a range of price points and also blends other cuisines. In addition, we do High Tea and offer a variety of hot and cold drinks including mocktails and cocktails which are not usually available in cafes. Last but not the least, it is the unique vibe! Ideally, we would like all our customers to leave the cafe having attained a state of Nirvana – complete bliss! Our focus is on touching all 5 senses through our food, drinks, service, music and the ambiance in a manner that delights our customers wanting them to not only come back again but also recommend us to their family and friends! EXPLORE NOW Our Flavours We believe in the adage that we are what we eat! Therefore, the basis of all our menu items has been simplicity, freshness & flavour. While the first two are important, the third is crucial for the palette! We blend the modern Australian cuisine with flavours inspired from Middle Eastern, Oriental and South Asian cuisines and therefore they also resonate well with the diverse communities here. Our creations go through multiple iterations with select customer groups, before we launch it to all our customers. Each of our creation is irresistibly chic with the right fusion of colors to create the picture-perfect moment. Our dishes are made with fresh, locally sourced ingredients that celebrate the best of Australian produce. Given we draw a lot of young people and families, providing a nutritious & balanced meal is a key focus in all our dishes. EXPLORE NOW Our Community The response from the local community since we opened doors till date has been overwhelmingly positive. This is testament to the fact that we have been in business for more than 8 years now! We are thankful for the love and support shown by the community but also their friends and families that visit us from all over Australia and the rest of the world when they are in Sydney! Our engagement with the local community is at multiple levels, from celebrating key occasions and festivals through special offers & dishes. Most recently we celebrated the tremendous performance at the Olympics by the Australian team by creating a special pancake in their honor. We also support other local businesses by promoting their products/services through our café outlets/ providing sponsorships/ gift vouchers. Our local community is our lifeblood. Needless to say, their love and support is crucial for our continued success and their constructive feedback helps us improve even further. EXPLORE NOW

Welcome to Top Impression Bakery, where every bite tells a story since 2015. We rolled up our sleeves and set up shop right outside Wolli Creek train station. Our goal is to bring you something innovative and distinctive that well represents Top Impression Bakery, while also providing a visual effect that enhances your experience. We see baking as more than just food—it’s a way to explore the endless possibilities of life. Order now HOME SHOKUPAN CAFE ABOUT INSTAGRAM WHOLESALE GIFT CARDS The differences in taste and texture among the four types of white Shokupan we offer Premium White Premium Yudane White Soft Milk Loaf Soft White Loaf Order now HOME SHOKUPAN CAFE ABOUT INSTAGRAM WHOLESALE GIFT CARDS Replicating the Japanese bread-making in Sydney Bread loaves by AKIPAN is produced with care and attention to the detail by a Japanese baker, who was born in Japan and knows about the bread in Japan inside out. Just as coffee and wine cultures that developed in Australia in their unique and original ways, bread culture introduced to Japan from the West has evolved in its own unique style, taking on board what the Japanese wanted to see in bread. In recent days, “Shokupan” the most standard bread loaves in the Japanese everyday lifestyle have shown noticeable advancement and the hotly-talked-about flavour is a result of hard work and continuous research by the numerous bakers in Japan. AKIPAN have thoroughly studied the new wave Shokupan, reviewed the ingredients and processes and researched how we can recreate this here in Sydney. In order to replicate the bread-making in Japan, AKIPAN brought most of the tools needed for bread-making from Japan. These include brushes ideal for applying butter, accurate scales that show numbers instantly, and Shokupan loaf tins developed in Japan for perfect heat conduction. They are all products of Japan’s great manufacturing technology and directly affects the flavour of the bread loaves. Furthermore, in order to produce the ultimate Shokupan, AKIPAN had to work on finding the perfect balance of ingredients, as well as the methodology that works here in Sydney while adhering to the techniques and ingredients established in Japan. As a result, we managed to produce AKIPAN’s bread loaves that are Japanese style and yet highly original and cannot be bought from anywhere else. It is our mission to add a new page to Sydney’s “food” scenes that is evolving at an unprecedented speed and bring to you the flavour of “Shokupan” which was not available in Australia until now.

STITCH COFFEE was born of an idea that coffee doesn’t need to be a standalone - it can be mixed together. We realised at an early stage that the art of blending coffee is the same as tailoring a piece of cloth. As a result, we stitched together origins with different flavours to bring forward the ultimate cup characteristics for everyone to enjoy. Daring, bold and unconventional, we aim to break the mould and bring specialty coffee to all. Sharing this craft and its fine coffee products is all for your enjoyment at home and beyond. We do this by creating connections with our suppliers and consumers from the very beginning of the coffee supply chain to the very end of the consumption process. With a focus on ensuring that consumers know about and have transparency about the entire coffee journey. We share information so that every participant in the coffee process succeeds, and our industry continues to thrive for decades to come. Innovation is one of our passions, bringing you coffee products that enable special moments shared over coffee. And we want this to happen anywhere and whenever, be it from our Broadway flagship store, in the comfort of your home or even when you are on the go! Bringing specialty coffee into every part of what we do starts with us ensuring that our wholesale customers (cafes and retailers) are knowledgeable through our coaching-style relationship. This helps to upskill them so that their offerings to you are of the highest level with a perfect cup of coffee, no matter the brewing method. We have become well known within our industry as a Specialty Coffee Roaster that is bold, fun and quality focused. We rotate single origins from all over the globe in an effort to bring variety and share knowledge with our consumers, as a platform to promote the work of coffee farmers across the continents. No favourites and no specialisation of region, but a focus on the farmer / producer – no matter where they were located. This is what makes up our community and feeds into our why, why we do what we do, why we exist. From pickers, farmers to roasters and coffee addicts, we are here to bring people together through coffee. “WE ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT CREATING UNIQUE, DELICIOUS COFFEE FROM AROUND THE WORLD AND TO CONNECT THESE WITH OUR CONSUMERS AS WE CELEBRATE THE WORK OF COFFEE PRODUCERS AND ALL THOSE ACROSS THE COFFEE JOURNEY. COFFEE TO US, IS A CRAFT ONLY POSSIBLE BY BRINGING COMMUNITIES TOGETHER.” OUR ORIGIN STORY At STITCH COFFEE we believe that coffee is much like a tapestry - it is a weaving of origins and flavours to create a delicious cup. Nawar Adra, owner and founder of STITCH COFFEE, had humble beginnings working as a barista in the iconic Western Sydney Suburbs cafe Circa Espresso. This is where Nawar started his roasting journey when Circa purchased their very own Probat P5 roaster for in-house production. During his time there, the focus was only on single origin coffees. However, Nawar gradually realised there was an artistry within the blending of origins. This merging of origins created a cup with distinct complexity, structure, and balance. The concept gave birth to STITCH COFFEE. We opened the doors to our roastery in 2015 and haven’t looked back. Today we are a company dedicated to creating connections through coffee, from green bean importers, to everyday coffee drinkers and everyone in between. Part of our offering goes beyond our coffee. It includes assisting cafes in up-skilling their baristas and teams, training them on extracting the perfect espresso and brew a delicious pour-over. Our love for coffee is fed by the daily home brewers and the cafes that serve our coffee, which is why education and knowledge sharing is so important for us. We will continue to source coffee ethically from around the world and ensure that we have the ability to communicate this with our community. We are continuously evolving our buying practises and fostering relationships with importers and farmers to ensure a healthy future for coffee. DIVERSITY & INCLUSIVITY It all starts with the heart of our company: our team. Our team members come from many countries and cultures, and that allows us to have a wide range of perspectives. Many points of view that come together and are stitched together into one big family. We believe in everyone’s potential to succeed by being a supportive workplace and setting our team up for success, just as we do with our business goals. SUSTAINABILITY & ETHICAL SOURCING STITCH COFFEE strive to forge a strong and long-lasting relationship with green bean importers who value sustainability as much as we do. We believe in empowering the entire supply chain in this industry and together make it better. Read more about our sustainability practices here. We are a highly visual brand, our packaging looks pretty nice (if we do say so ourselves) and we also want to be kind to our world. For the last few years we have endeavoured to move towards making our packaging recyclable and reduce waste all-round. We are proud to say we are good and clean for our planet, presenting new ways to package coffee that are different to other coffee products whilst maintaining the quality of the cup you brew COMMUNITY & COLLABORATION The coffee community is our why. From pickers, farmers to roasters and coffee addicts, we are here to bring people together through coffee. The ideology that we operate on is - If you want to go fast, go alone. If you want to go far, go together (African proverb). When one part of our community succeeds, we all do. We advocate on behalf of our fellow roasters to help them access great quality green beans. This is the power of co-roasting! Our co-roasting initiatives are powered by our sister BRAND ECRE. Find out more about it here. We support our wholesale customers with continuous training, connection to suppliers and business advice. We believe we only succeed when we stick together – or stitch together. GROWTH & EXPANSION We are bold, we are trailblazers, we thrive off being daring, unconventional and pushing boundaries. Never afraid to go big, go first and go where others don’t venture. ‘First movers’ is our favourite combo of words and although we are not always the first, we are a leader in the coffee industry. We innovate in a wide range of products and offer something for all types of coffee lovers. Innovation never ends as we don’t want to miss a beat to continually move forward, to better ourselves, learn and grow, whilst making it accessible to the specialty coffee industry. brand story products stores partner recruitment English more information here→ brand story products stores partner recruitment English the inspiration of logo beginning originator renaming innovator new style tea by inspiration the inspiration of logo Inspired by the side-profile and simple lines seen on ancient coins, our classic logo was born by combining this aesthetic with the everyday gesture of taking a hearty sip of tea. beginning In 2011, a 20-year-old young man, frustrated by the lack of pure and great-tasting tea drinks on the market, decided to open a tea shop that served the kind of tea he loved. After over a year of preparation, he began thinking bigger: How can we make traditional tea cooler? Eventually, in his home kitchen, he developed a beta version of the first Cheese Tea — the salted cheese green tea. In May 2012, he opened the very first royaltea ( heytea’s predecessor ) in Jiangbianli, China. This marked the birthplace of the new style tea era. originator Before 2012, using cheap creamer powder, artificial flavors and coloring was the industry norm — almost no tea shops used natural ingredients. “You can’t make good milk tea without creamer powder,” many industry veterans claimed back then. Why not? Following our instincts, we chose a completely new path — using real tea, real milk, and natural ingredients to create the very first cheese tea. This cup of cheese tea rewrote industry history and marked the dawn of a new era in tea drinks. In the years that followed, starting from inspiration, we introduced a series of beloved products made with natural ingredients: Cloud Mango, Grape Boom, Supreme Brown Sugar Bobo Milk Tea, Mulberry Strawberry Boom, Kale Boost Tea, Cloud Coconut Blue... renaming Starting from a small alley, this cup of naturally crafted cheese tea quickly won customers’ hearts. Thanks to enthusiastic word-of-mouth recommendations, our stores began seeing spectacular lines. However, this popularity also attracted waves of counterfeiters. Copycat shops mushroomed nationwide, severely damaging our brand identity. To protect our brand, we made a decisive move: we completely rebranded from “royaltea” to the trademarked “HEYTEA”. This wasn’t just a name change — it was staying true to our roots while embarking on a new chapter. innovator Staying true to the original vision of our humble shop in Jiangbianli, China, we remain committed to natural ingredients and uncompromising quality. Driven by our own values, we strive to push the entire new style tea industry forward — toward a better future. We pledge full transparency and true quality in every handcrafted drink across all our stores. new style tea by inspiration Neither as stimulating as coffee nor as intoxicating as alcohol, we believe a good cup of tea has always had the power to bring calm and ease. From that little shop in Jiangbianli, China, we reimagined what tea could be in today’s world. With a desire to give new expression to this ancient Eastern tradition, we craft each cup with natural ingredients, offering a moment of quiet pleasure and mindful enjoyment in every sip. more information here→ brand story products stores partner recruitment English more information here→ brand story products stores partner recruitment English heytea heytea lab heytea teabar Tea Pavilion｜Infinitus Plaza Store, Hong Kong SAR, China On March 24, 2026, we opened another place to pause in the city at Infinitus Plaza, Hong Kong. With natural wood, textured stone, and greenery throughout, the space takes the form of a pavilion tea room. Inspired by the quiet atmosphere of a city park, it invites you to slow down for a moment whenever you pass by, and enjoy a cup of tea. Tea First｜Shamian DP Store, Guangzhou, China In our 11th year in Guangzhou, we finally arrived in Shamian. Located within Shamian Island’s century-old historic buildings, the space draws inspiration from Guangzhou’s morning tea culture. Bamboo weaving brings greenery indoors, creating a place to yum cha, relax, and enjoy tea the way locals have for generations. Tea Fossils｜Jing’an Joy City Store, Shanghai, China Inspired by archaeology, the store presents a future-facing tea culture site set in the year 3025. Bronze kettles, tea bowl fragments, and “tea fossils” reveal memories of old Shanghai tea stalls and hot-water houses. Visit the store and open the “Tea Fossil 3025 Archive” to discover tea-drinking clues from 2025. more information here→

Desserts by Night PATISSERIE & CAFÉ HOME MENU ABOUT CONTACT RESERVE A TABLE OUR STORY Born for the Hours After Dinner. We exist because sweet cravings don't follow a schedule. Desserts by Night is a late-night French patisserie built for the city that stays up. WHERE IT BEGAN A simple idea, taken seriously. The concept was straightforward: build a place that treats dessert as the main event, not an afterthought. No padded menus, no rushed last-course sweets. Just an honest, beautiful patisserie open when you actually want to go. Originating in Australia with a deep affection for Parisian café culture, Desserts by Night planted its first roots in Springvale, a suburb that already knew how to eat well and stay up late. WHAT WE BELIEVE Dessert deserves its own spotlight. ✦ French Craft Every item on our menu draws from classical French patisserie technique. Choux pastry, entremets, mille-feuille. Made properly, not approximated. ☾ Open Late, Always Our hours exist for you. Monday to Thursday until 11:30 pm. Friday to Sunday from 4 am onwards. Cravings have no curfew, and neither do we. ✶ Made In-House Our pastry kitchen runs fresh every day. What's on the counter was made here, by people who care about what they're putting in front of you. ▶ A Space to Linger No rush. Come alone. Bring someone. Stay for two courses or four. The whole idea is that you have somewhere good to be after 9 pm. THE ATMOSPHERE Midnight in Paris, every night in Springvale. Step inside and the city noise softens. Warm light reflects off gilded fixtures. The display case glows with glazed tarts and layered cakes. You could be in the 6th arrondissement at 11 pm on a Tuesday. Except you're at 317 Springvale Rd, and the parking is better. We designed the space to hold a mood. Every seat, every candle, every note of the playlist is considered. It is meant to feel like an occasion, even on a Wednesday. "Some places serve dessert. We are dessert." THE KITCHEN Pastry is a discipline. We take it seriously. Our kitchen team works through the night preparing every item from scratch. Crepe batter is rested. Ganache is tempered. Tart shells are blind-baked. There are no shortcuts in a patisserie that takes its name from the night. The result is a menu that changes with the seasons and rewards regulars who know to come back and try what's new. SEE THE MENU COME VISIT We're open when you need us. The Combi story started in Byron Bay, New South Wales with simple toasties and coffee being sold out of an actual Volkswagen combi van. Fast-forward a few years and over 1500 kilometres and Combi now serves as a pillar of health, wellbeing, and spirituality in the Elwood community. All coffee sold at Combi Elwood is 100% organic and certified fair trade. 100% Organic Coffee Sold Here About Us Acai Bowls, Smoothies + So Much More A feel good destination where great vibes and nutritious eats collide! At 138 - 140 Ormond Rd, Elwood our healthy haven is all about food that’s good for the mind, body, planet and soul! We’re talking organic smoothies, açai bowls, savoury snacks and a selection of delicious, raw/vegan cakes. Our menus is designed to be vibrant, guilt-free and full of all the flavours mother nature intended. See Our Menu Oooh Baby I Like it Raw! Custom Cakes by Combi. The same question comes up every time: "Where did you get that? Can I try it?" Now you can. We've opened up a small number of exclusive ride experiences so you can see exactly what it feels like to ride a premium handcrafted European sidecar paired with one of our e-bikes, before you decide to bring one home. Whether you're thinking of a sidecar for your dog, your child, or simply want to carry more on your daily rides, there's no better way to know than to actually feel it. Our sidecars are made to last, built from durable fibreglass, lightweight yet incredibly sturdy. The pivot attachment gives you a smooth, natural ride so it never feels like you're hauling something heavy. You just ride. And your co-pilot sits beside you, taking it all in. Spots are strictly limited to keep each experience personal and unhurried. Book below, show up, and let the ride speak for itself. Everything You Need to Know Before You Arrive What to Expect 1. Book Your Spot Spots are limited, so we recommend booking in advance. You'll receive a confirmation with everything you need to know before you arrive. 2. Arrive and Meet the Team Come along to our Melbourne location and meet the Matcha Inc. team. We'll walk you through the sidecar setup, answer any questions, and get you comfortable before you head off. 3. Get Fitted and Ready to Ride We'll match you with the right e-bike and sidecar configuration for your ride. If you're bringing your dog or child, we'll make sure they're safely and comfortably settled in before you set off. 4. Hit the Road Enjoy your sidecar experience through Melbourne at your own pace. Feel the smooth pivot attachment in action, the quiet power of the e-bike, and what it's like to have your co-pilot right beside you. 5. Ask Us Anything After your ride, we're here to chat. Whether you have questions about the sidecars, the e-bikes, or anything else, we're happy to share everything we know. Reserve Your Spot Schedule & Pricing Once you submit your booking request, we'll be in touch to confirm a time that works for you. Duration Each ride experience runs for approximately 60-120 minutes, giving you enough time to get comfortable, explore, and enjoy the ride at your own pace. Cost Completely free. No catch, no commitment. We just want you to experience the ride for yourself. Group size Experiences are kept small and personal, with limited spots available each session. We recommend booking early to secure your preferred time. Location All ride experiences depart from a beautiful laneway in the CBD. Full details will be confirmed in your booking confirmation. Mondo began with a simple idea, to bring the world closer, one scoop at a time. We’ve travelled, taste, and dreamed our way through flavours that feel like memories. From creamy classics to modern twists, Mondo is where nostalgia meets discovery. Because for us, ice cream isn’t just dessert, it’s a story.. Our Founder. At the heart of Mondo is founder and gelato artist Rio Olivetti, whose approach blends technical precision with a genuine sense of joy. Trained in Bologna under masters of traditional Italian gelato making, Rio brings a deep respect for craft, balance, and quality, paired with a curiosity that keeps things playful. For him, gelato is both discipline and freedom, something refined but never rigid, always evolving, always made to be shared. Our Home. Mondo’s home reflects that same philosophy. Housed within a heritage building that has stood for over a century, the space honours what came before while inviting something entirely new. Warm tones, sculptural details, and subtle references to travel and time create an atmosphere that feels familiar yet transportive. It is a place designed for lingering, for conversation, for watching the city pass by with a scoop slowly melting in hand. The Concept. Flavour is where Mondo truly travels. The menu shifts and rotates, guided by seasonality, memory, and imagination. Each scoop is carefully considered, layered, and balanced, designed to surprise without overwhelming. Some flavours feel comforting and familiar, others hint at places far from here, but all are crafted with the same intention. To spark curiosity, invite discovery, and turn a simple moment into something worth remembering. Free from artificial colours and flavours, each scoop is designed to feel clean, expressive, and true to its origin — from nutty matcha pistachio to bright seasonal fruits and refined plant-based creations. Fusing Cultures, Fusing Flavours Rooted in Japanese inspiration and Melbourne creativity, Kōri explores the meeting point of cultures through flavour, season, and design. And so, in the very same space where Big Bang Yogurt began, we launched Her Little Patisserie, a small bakery dedicated to crafting delightful cakes and pastries. brand story products stores partner recruitment English more information here→ brand story products stores partner recruitment English the inspiration of logo beginning originator renaming innovator new style tea by inspiration the inspiration of logo Inspired by the side-profile and simple lines seen on ancient coins, our classic logo was born by combining this aesthetic with the everyday gesture of taking a hearty sip of tea. beginning In 2011, a 20-year-old young man, frustrated by the lack of pure and great-tasting tea drinks on the market, decided to open a tea shop that served the kind of tea he loved. After over a year of preparation, he began thinking bigger: How can we make traditional tea cooler? Eventually, in his home kitchen, he developed a beta version of the first Cheese Tea — the salted cheese green tea. In May 2012, he opened the very first royaltea ( heytea’s predecessor ) in Jiangbianli, China. This marked the birthplace of the new style tea era. originator Before 2012, using cheap creamer powder, artificial flavors and coloring was the industry norm — almost no tea shops used natural ingredients. “You can’t make good milk tea without creamer powder,” many industry veterans claimed back then. Why not? Following our instincts, we chose a completely new path — using real tea, real milk, and natural ingredients to create the very first cheese tea. This cup of cheese tea rewrote industry history and marked the dawn of a new era in tea drinks. In the years that followed, starting from inspiration, we introduced a series of beloved products made with natural ingredients: Cloud Mango, Grape Boom, Supreme Brown Sugar Bobo Milk Tea, Mulberry Strawberry Boom, Kale Boost Tea, Cloud Coconut Blue... renaming Starting from a small alley, this cup of naturally crafted cheese tea quickly won customers’ hearts. Thanks to enthusiastic word-of-mouth recommendations, our stores began seeing spectacular lines. However, this popularity also attracted waves of counterfeiters. Copycat shops mushroomed nationwide, severely damaging our brand identity. To protect our brand, we made a decisive move: we completely rebranded from “royaltea” to the trademarked “HEYTEA”. This wasn’t just a name change — it was staying true to our roots while embarking on a new chapter. innovator Staying true to the original vision of our humble shop in Jiangbianli, China, we remain committed to natural ingredients and uncompromising quality. Driven by our own values, we strive to push the entire new style tea industry forward — toward a better future. We pledge full transparency and true quality in every handcrafted drink across all our stores. new style tea by inspiration Neither as stimulating as coffee nor as intoxicating as alcohol, we believe a good cup of tea has always had the power to bring calm and ease. From that little shop in Jiangbianli, China, we reimagined what tea could be in today’s world. With a desire to give new expression to this ancient Eastern tradition, we craft each cup with natural ingredients, offering a moment of quiet pleasure and mindful enjoyment in every sip. more information here→ brand story products stores partner recruitment English more information here→ brand story products stores partner recruitment English heytea heytea lab heytea teabar Tea Pavilion｜Infinitus Plaza Store, Hong Kong SAR, China On March 24, 2026, we opened another place to pause in the city at Infinitus Plaza, Hong Kong. With natural wood, textured stone, and greenery throughout, the space takes the form of a pavilion tea room. Inspired by the quiet atmosphere of a city park, it invites you to slow down for a moment whenever you pass by, and enjoy a cup of tea. Tea First｜Shamian DP Store, Guangzhou, China In our 11th year in Guangzhou, we finally arrived in Shamian. Located within Shamian Island’s century-old historic buildings, the space draws inspiration from Guangzhou’s morning tea culture. Bamboo weaving brings greenery indoors, creating a place to yum cha, relax, and enjoy tea the way locals have for generations. Tea Fossils｜Jing’an Joy City Store, Shanghai, China Inspired by archaeology, the store presents a future-facing tea culture site set in the year 3025. Bronze kettles, tea bowl fragments, and “tea fossils” reveal memories of old Shanghai tea stalls and hot-water houses. Visit the store and open the “Tea Fossil 3025 Archive” to discover tea-drinking clues from 2025. more information here→

ABOUT US PRODUCT & MENU LOCATION CONTACT ChaTraMue, the iconic traditional Thai tea brand, officially launched its first Australian flagship store on Swanston Street, Melbourne in March 2026. What began as a small shop in Bangkok’s Chinatown in 1925 has evolved from a tea importer into the creator of the world-renowned signature red tea blend, perfectly crafted for Thailand's tropical climate. By sourcing premium leaves from the highlands of Chiang Rai and pioneering innovative production methods—including early machinery once hauled by elephants—this third-generation family business transformed from a bulk supplier into a global lifestyle icon. Although its roots date back further, the brand name ChaTraMue (widely recognised as "Number One Brand") was officially established in 1945. Today, instantly distinguished by its "Thumbs Up" logo, the brand is credited with popularising Thai Milk Tea across more than 10 countries. For us, it’s never just about the drink; it’s about offering Melburnians an authentic experience that feels like stepping into the heart of Thailand. From the moment you arrive, you’ll immerse yourself in the vibrant spirit and heritage of the Original Thai Tea. ChaTraMue Australia @ 2026. All rights reserved. We offer an inviting and relaxed space that’s perfect for brunch enthusiasts, coffee lovers and anyone seeking a moment of tranquillity, making us one of if not the best café in Melbourne CBD. Meet The Team At Tomo’s Little Collins, our warm hospitality and Japanese-inspired café experience are brought to life by a small group of dedicated professionals. Each person plays a key role in shaping the food, drinks and service our guests enjoy every day. Rina Imaeda — Manager Rina plays a key role in the day-to-day operations of the café. Skilled in both coffee and matcha preparation, she supports the beverage bar throughout service and helps maintain consistency across the menu. Focused and dependable, Rina works behind the scenes to keep the café running smoothly — from coordinating service flow to ensuring the kitchen and front-of-house stay aligned. Her steady presence and care can be felt in the quality and rhythm of daily service. At Izakaya Miyazaki, our chefs honour this heritage through traditional techniques that preserve its natural balance and depth. It is an authentic expression of Japan’s Wagyu tradition, brought to life with precision, care and respect - and our commitment to serving the best Wagyu in Melbourne CBD. SEE MENU PREMIUM SOURCING DIRECT FROM JAPAN’S MIYACHIKU COOPERATIVE ミヤチク協同組合直送 Our Wagyu is sourced exclusively through the Miyachiku Cooperative in Japan - the home of authentic A5 Miyazaki Wagyu. This renowned collective represents generations of farmers dedicated to raising cattle with exceptional care, sustainable methods and an unwavering pursuit of quality. Each cut we import is fully traceable and certified, ensuring the same standards served in Japan’s most acclaimed restaurants. Through this direct connection, Izakaya Miyazaki brings Melbourne diners the rare opportunity to experience genuine Japanese Wagyu of unmatched provenance and heritage. DIFFERENT WAYS TO ENJOY WAGYU 和牛の味わい方 Wagyu is treated as an art form, prepared with care to highlight its texture, flavour and balance. Each preparation reveals a different side of A5 Miyazaki Wagyu - from the quiet theatre of Japanese hot pot to the lively heat of the yakiniku BBQ table. It can be enjoyed raw, charcoal-seared, char-grilled or slow-simmered, each method allowing the marbling to shine in its own way. Every expression carries the heritage and mastery of Japan’s finest beef, brought to life in the heart of Melbourne CBD. BOOK NOW A5 MIYAZAKI WAGYU CUTS WE SERVE EYE FILLET (THE RAREST CUT) 和牛ヒレ Profile: Silky, tender, and supremely juicy. Availability: Only ~7kg of eye fillet can be sourced from each cow, making it a true delicacy. Why it’s special: Considered the “jewel” of the cow, the eye fillet is nearly impossible to overcook - it remains tender and flavourful no matter the preparation. RIB EYE / SIRLOIN / TENDERLOIN A5宮崎牛 リブロース・サーロイン・ヒレ Profile: Highly marbled, buttery, and melt-in-the-mouth. Best enjoyed with: Yakiniku, steak, or shabu shabu. Why it’s special: These cuts showcase the signature Miyazaki Wagyu balance of richness and elegance—perfect for those who want to experience Wagyu at its most luxurious. CHUCK RIBS / CLOD / SHORT RIBS A5宮崎牛 肩ロース・ウデ・ショートリブ Profile: Juicy, flavour-forward, and slightly smoky when grilled. Best enjoyed with: Yakiniku or slow grilling over charcoal (robatayaki). Why it’s special: These cuts bring out a deeper Wagyu flavour with a satisfying chew, ideal for those who enjoy a robust, meaty bite. TOPSIDE / BOTTOMSIDE 日本酒醸造の象徴 Profile: Leaner, delicate, and tender when thinly sliced. Best enjoyed with: Shabu shabu (Japanese hotpot). Why it’s special: Their subtle flavours shine when cooked quickly in broth, making them perfect for guests who prefer lighter textures without sacrificing taste. AT GOOD DAZE CANTEEN, WE BELIEVE THAT ICE CREAM IS MORE THAN JUST A TREAT—IT’S A CELEBRATION OF CULTURE, CREATIVITY, AND COMMUNITY. EVERY SCOOP WE SERVE IS INSPIRED BY THE FLAVORS AND TRADITIONS OF THE WORLD. LOCATED IN THE VIBRANT SUBURB OF FITZROY, OUR SHOP IS A LOVE LETTER TO MELBOURNE’S RICH CULTURAL DIVERSITY! At Good Daze Canteen, we strive to scoop you away from life's miseries for a moment, inviting you to immerse yourself in the vibrant cultural tapestry of the world with an open and curious mind, and to awaken a childlike sense of adventure and wonder. OUR STORY... WE’RE TWO PASSIONATE UNI STUDENTS IN OUR EARLY 20’S, WHO STARTED THIS BUSINESS WITH ABSOLUTELY ZERO EXPERIENCE, NOTHING BUT THE SHARED LOVE OF ICE CREAM AND A DREAM. OUR LACK OF EXPERIENCE IMPARTED US TO STIVE FOR ABSOLUTE PERFECTION AND PROVOKED US TO ALWAYS HAVE AN OPEN MIND TOWARDS LEARNING AND FEEDBACK. FOR TWO YEARS, WE TIRELESSLY DEVOTED OURSELVES TO TESTING THOUSANDS OF BATCHES, PUTTING IN COUNTLESS HOURS OF HARD WORK TO BRING SOMETHING TRULY SPECIAL TO MELBOURNE. WE TOOK OUR PASSION ON THE ROAD WITH GELATO CARTS, HOSTING POP-UPS IN SHOPPING CENTERS AND DOING EVENTS TO BRING OUR CREATIONS DIRECTLY TO THE PEOPLE. EVERY ELEMENT OF EACH FLAVOUR IN OUR STORE IS A UNIQUE RECIPE, DEVELOPED FROM SCRATCH BY US, CRAFTED THROUGH ENDLESS EXPERIMENTATION AND A RELENTLESS PURSUIT OF EXCELLENCE. WE BUILT A STORE, DEVELOPED THE BRAND, DESIGNED EVERY PIECE OF BRANDING, AND CREATED A SEXY LINEUP OF FLAVOURS—ALL WITH OUR OWN TWO HANDS. Our Values: EXCELLENCE EXCELLENCE IS AT THE HEART OF EVERYTHING WE DO. FROM THE QUALITY OF OUR INGREDIENTS TO THE CREATIVITY OF OUR FLAVORS, WE ARE COMMITTED TO MAKING EVERY PRODUCT AND ELEMENT OF OUR BUSINESS THE BEST IT CAN BE. OUR RIGOROUS ITERATIVE PROCESS HELPS US PERFECT EACH FACET OF OUR OFFERINGS TO THE BEST OF OUR ABILITIES. WE DO THIS TO HONOUR YOU FOR CHOOSING US! CURIOSITY & APPRECIATION WE’RE ENDLESSLY CURIOUS ABOUT THE WORLD AROUND US. WHETHER IT'S EXPERIMENTING WITH NEW INGREDIENTS, EXPLORING DIFFERENT CUISINES, OR EMBRACING DIVERSE WAYS OF LIVING, WE BELIEVE THAT TRYING NEW THINGS—AND TRULY APPRECIATING THEM—IS THE BEAUTY OF LIFE. AT GOOD DAZE CANTEEN, EVERY FLAVOR IS AN INVITATION TO EXPLORE AND ENJOY. AUTHENTICITY AUTHENTICITY IS THE ONLY THING MORE IMPORTANT TO US THAN QUALITY. WE STAY TRUE TO THE CULTURAL INSPIRATIONS BEHIND OUR FLAVORS, ENSURING THAT EACH SCOOP IS A GENUINE REFLECTION OF THE TRADITIONS AND STORIES THAT INSPIRE US. WE BELIEVE IN BEING REAL, BOTH IN OUR INGREDIENTS AND OUR INTERACTIONS WITH OUR CUSTOMERS.

About Pidapipo 1 2 3 4 5 6 ABOUT PIDAPIPO Pidapipo is Melbourne’s home of authentic Italian gelato: artisanal, churned fresh daily in-store, and made by hand from the best seasonal ingredients. Anchored in tradition and inspired by joy, everything we create comes from Italian values of craft, family and flavour. From our first scoops on Lygon Street more than ten years ago to our experimental Fitzroy Laboratorio today, Pidapipo has always been about sharing the simple happiness of gelato. OUR STORY The name Pidapipo comes from a game our nonno taught us as children – a reminder that food should always bring play and connection. Founder Lisa Valmorbida trained at Carpigiani Gelato University in Bologna, an esteemed gelato school. There she learnt the Italian traditions we still live by today: fresh fruit, small batches, no artificial colours or flavourings, and recipes carefully balanced for perfect texture and taste. After working in Italy’s best gelaterias, Lisa returned to Melbourne. With her brother Jamie, she opened a pop-up shop in Carlton that quickly won the hearts of the city. Soon after came our permanent Lygon Street flagship, followed by Windsor and the CBD – with fountains of Nutella, colourful gelato cakes, and rotating monthly menus that evolve with the seasons. BEYOND GELATO While gelato will always be at the heart of Pidapipo, we’ve grown into a family of products and experiences – all connected by the same spirit of Italian craft and joy. Gelato Cakes: Inspired by the great pasticcerie of Milan, our gelato cakes are handcrafted for celebrations both big and small. Single Origin Chocolate: made in-house at Fitzroy using Dominican Republic cacao. Fitzroy Laboratorio: a sleek space for experimentation, where all our flavours are developed and sent out to be churned fresh daily at every store. Gelato Carts: scoops to-go. The perfect option when it comes to adding an Italian touch to your event or party. OUR MISSION We believe in gelato done well: artisanal craft, authentic Italian tradition, endless complimentary taste tests, and a spark of joy to make every visit memorable. Our stores are designed to bring people together, our recipes honour the best ingredients, and our team is united by one goal – to bring a smile with every scoop. OUR STORES Find us in Carlton, Windsor, the CBD and at our Fitzroy Laboratorio. Pidapipo acknowledges the Wurundjeri people of the Kulin nation, the traditional custodians of this land, and pay our respect to the Wurundjeri Elders, past, present and emerging. About Us HELLO AND WELCOME TO MY OH MY ESPRESSO, MAKERS OF MAGIC. We’re a local café for local people. If you like the Richmond area, you’ll feel right at home here. Hello and welcome to My Oh My Espresso, Makers of Magic. Since 2018, My Oh My Espresso has been a haven for the local community who come to enjoy great coffee and each other’s company. We welcome anyone who wants to experience the warm hospitality that is Richmond. As the first café with a window to Swan Street, we got to know our local community better than most. We’ve seen friendships made, businesses thrive, and families grow. My Oh My is a place to connect, share a story, have a chat and leave with a good feeling in your belly. For the lovers of magic, we’re the makers of magic. Crafting exceptional coffee, signature offerings & memorable moments. Our mission is to uplift by serving with intention, warmth and authenticity. Rooted in wellness, we blend conscious choices with everyday indulgence, creating a space where every visit leaves you feeling a little better than before. Swan Street in 1889 Swan Street was named after the White Swan Hotel which was built in 1852 and runs through Richmond, Cremorne and Burnley. The café’s colours and décor were designed to respect and honour the heritage architecture that began during this time. It looks a little different now! Today Richmond is home to world class street art and the best cafes in town. With the MCG, AAMI Park and the Rod Laver Arena within walking distance, the vibe is upbeat and there is always something going on here. We’re always open to feedback to improve the quality of service. We have a committed, warm, and friendly team who care about delivering exceptional coffee, food and service every day. We’re a local café for local people. If you like the Richmond area, you’ll feel right at home here. Fusing cultures, fusing flavours Our Story Kōri Ice Cream is a Japanese-inspired ice cream studio in Melbourne, creating small-batch flavours, celebration cakes, and sweet moments shaped by season, craft, and design. The Founders Kōri Ice Cream was founded by pastry chefs Joane Yeoh and Bernard Chu, whose shared love of travel, flavour, and quiet craftsmanship brought the studio to life. Drawing inspiration from Japan’s balance of precision and restraint, they created a space where thoughtful technique meets a distinctly Melbourne sensibility. Crafted in Small Batches Every flavour at Kōri is made in small batches using carefully selected ingredients and a restrained approach to sweetness. Free from artificial colours and flavours, each scoop is designed to feel clean, expressive, and true to its origin — from nutty matcha pistachio to bright seasonal fruits and refined plant-based creations. A Space to Gather More than an ice cream shop, Kōri is a place shaped by atmosphere, design, and the gentle rituals of gathering. Each location reflects a contemporary, future-leaning aesthetic that mirrors the clarity of the flavours — inviting guests to slow down, share, and savour the moment. Fusing Cultures, Fusing Flavours Rooted in Japanese inspiration and Melbourne creativity, Kōri explores the meeting point of cultures through flavour, season, and design. Whether shared as a simple scoop, a celebration cake, or a fleeting seasonal creation, each experience is crafted to feel thoughtful, beautiful, and quietly memorable. Our coffee menu is like a wine list - you may choose by style, country, flavour profile - or if you are looking for a recommendation, we're happy to help. LEARN MORE WE’RE COMMITED TO CHANGE We engage in a range of sustainable measures at our premises, to ensure that we are doing what we love with as little cost to the planet as possible. Sustainable Construction We built ONA Melbourne with sustainability in mind, using solar energy to power all the electricity in the building. Solar Energy ONA Melbourne was built out of simple, raw and recycled materials. Designed by the talented team at Breathe architects. Sourcing only the best local ingredients to ensure everything we put on the plate is at its best, full of flavour and a representation of what we stand for at ONA Coffee Melbourne. Harvard studied us. Dubai raised us. Chai defined us. Not just a brand. A daily ritual for millions. Some revolutions start with ideas. Ours started with a cup of chai. Iced or hot — chai has no season. Only devotion. Dubai summers are bold. So is our Karak. When the heat rises, the chai ritual stays cool. Dubai Summer · FiLLi is speaking Scroll The Founder THE CHAI MASTER Mr Rafih FiLLi is a fun loving person and enjoys being in the company of his friends. The history of the name FiLLi traces back to his school days, where his friends gave Mr Rafih the title FiLLi. Little did anyone know that this name given for the sake of fun would one day lead to the establishment of FiLLi. The signature FiLLi Zafran Tea is a result of his own determination to introduce a specialty tea in the market that people would love. Today, this chaiwala runs 100+ locations across 14 countries, under the brand ‘FiLLi Cafe’, with a significant presence in UAE. But still, FiLLi claims that the process of brewing the crowd-pleaser was difficult and that the taste only gradually caught on. . “I just experimented with a tea bag and gave it to the regulars, and they liked it.” After seeing the beverage gain popularity among his usual customers, FiLLi stepped up its promotion among his clientele, surviving purely on word of mouth. FiLLi’s concept of reﬁning and repackaging the traditional tea worked. The entrepreneur has struck a chord with the local market as he has unearthed a horde of tea lovers in the UAE, a market that was traditionally thought to be dominated by coﬀee drinkers. Growth has been steady for FiLLi who opened his second store in Dubai’s Mankhool area in 2008. The home-grown chain aims to have at least, 127 stores in the UAE by 2025. Global Expansion FILLI LEGACY UAE’s favorite chai brand. FiLLi has become a renowned brand for tea enthusiasts in the UAE and around the globe, with its intriguing inception story of transforming from a small local cafe to a thriving international chain. Founded by Rafih FiLLi in Dubai, FiLLi Cafe is a fast casual chain of cafés originating from the United Arab Emirates that has successfully expanded its presence to nine other countries, including the UK, USA, Oman, Qatar, Nepal, Mauritius, India and Pakistan. The brand is celebrated for its signature 'Zafran Tea'—a unique saffron-infused chai blend. Alongside tea, FiLLi offers a diverse menu of snacks and beverages, such as iced chai, milkshakes, mocktails, bun kebabs, sandwiches, foodles, momos, and more, catering to Indian, Middle Eastern, and international tastes. Today, FiLLi is a sought-after name in the F&B industry, with a growing and loyal customer base that appreciates their offerings in the UAE and beyond. We want to be recognized as the world’s largest and the most admired tea brand in the world by enlarging their business empire throughout the UAE market and also globally, along with providing their customers with the best flavors of teas and lip-smacking food. While there's some friendly rivalry with New Zealand over various food origins, the lamington is widely acknowledged as an Australian creation. What makes a lamington a lamington? Three essential elements define a lamington: sponge cake, chocolate coating, and a layer of desiccated coconut. This combination of textures and flavours - the soft cake, smooth chocolate, and crispy coconut - is what makes a lamington a lamington. We at Tokyo Lamington pushes the boundaries of a lamington with our creations. Is there egg in your lamington? Yes, our lamingtons contain cooked pasteurised eggs as they provide structure and lightness to our sponge cake. Saying that, our vegan lamington is egg-free. Is there gelatin in your lamington? Some of our lamington contains halal gelatin in the cream, with the exception of our vegan lamington. How long can you keep lamingtons? Home Gifting Corporate Gifting Gift cards Lookbook Collaborations Contact About Order now Our journey so far From Tokyo to Sydney Scene: Cool autumn evening on a park bench after few too many highballs from a business meeting just before then. The conversation started like this, Eddie: I'm surprised how well lamingtons are selling in the cafe in Tokyo. Min: Really? Imagine doing a shop that sells only lamingtons in Tokyo, how troll is that. Eddie: You laugh, it might actually work. Min: LOL! We actually did a draft concept in the hotel the very same night, though details were a little blurry, we laughed and passed out soon after. It was about the same time when covid struck and change our lives. At the usher of the Australian government, we canned our plans for Tokyo and came back to Sydney. With nothing much going on, we thought it would be good to give Tokyo Lamington a try in Australia. Little did we know that it would become what it is today. We spent our time in hospitality enough to know how hard it is. We vowed to create a better space for the team and ourselves. Our goal was not just to create great lamingtons, but to build a business that reflected our values of sustainability, inclusivity, and diversity. We're proud to have built a team that celebrates diversity and prioritizes staff well-being. We know that an inclusive and supportive workplace is essential to creating a strong and resilient team, and we're committed to fostering a work environment where everyone feels valued and respected. We believe that food should be delicious, but it should also be responsible and sustainable. That's why we carefully source our ingredients from local suppliers and prioritise using sustainable practices in everything we do, like recycled and compostable packaging, so you can enjoy our cakes and coffee guilt-free. What started off as joke on a park bench in Tokyo is now a little bakery in Sydney and Melbourne run by this little family. A toastie that hit different — one loaded with the bold, sun-soaked flavours of the Caribbean. Mango chutney, Bajan hot sauce, jerk spice, tamarind. The kind of thing you'd find at a rum shop on a backstreet in Bridgetown, not on a cafe menu in Melbourne. So we built it ourselves. Barbados Slim was born — a little slice of the islands dropped right into the heart of Windsor. Step through the door and you're somewhere else. The colours, the energy, the music. Picture yourself wandering the streets of Barbados — past chattel houses painted every colour under the sun, the smell of spice drifting from open kitchens, locals laughing and liming on every corner. That's the feeling we bottle up and serve with every toastie and every cup. This isn't just a cafe. It's a trip. Come experience the warmth of the Caribbean without leaving Windsor. 🇧🇧 One bite and you're in Barbados. 🥪 THE GOOD STUFF Our Famous Toasties Caribbean-inspired flavour bombs, toasted to golden perfection Sweet Fuh Days $18.50 Slow-cooked pulled pork, creamy brie, mango chutney, and caramelised onion, pressed in golden sourdough. Privacy Policy Terms of Service Home Retail Shop Wholesale Enquiries Customer Log in About Our story Founded in 2018, Stromae's Premium Coffee began with a simple mission: to bring the world's finest coffee beans directly to your cup. What started as a small roastery has grown into a passionate community of coffee lovers dedicated to unparalleled quality, sustainability, and the perfect brew. Sourcing with purpose We believe great coffee starts at the source. That's why we work directly with farmers in Ethiopia, Colombia, Brazil, Guatemala, Kenya, and Costa Rica, building long-term relationships based on mutual respect and fair compensation. Our direct trade model ensures farmers receive premium prices for their exceptional beans, while we gain access to the finest lots each harvest season. This approach supports sustainable farming practices and helps preserve coffee-growing communities for generations to come. The art of roasting Our roasting philosophy is simple: let the beans speak for themselves. We use small-batch roasting techniques to carefully develop each origin's unique flavor profile, from bright and fruity Ethiopian beans to rich, chocolatey Colombian varieties. Every batch at Stromae's is meticulously monitored and adjusted to achieve the perfect roast level—whether light, medium, or dark. Our experienced roasters use a combination of traditional methods and modern technology to ensure consistency and excellence in every bag. Our core values Passion for quality We obsess over every detail, from bean selection to final packaging, ensuring you receive only the finest coffee. Sustainability first Environmental stewardship guides our decisions, from eco-friendly packaging to carbon-neutral shipping. Community focused We believe in building lasting relationships with farmers, customers, and our local community. Ready to experience the difference? brand story products stores partner recruitment English more information here→ brand story products stores partner recruitment English the inspiration of logo beginning originator renaming innovator new style tea by inspiration the inspiration of logo Inspired by the side-profile and simple lines seen on ancient coins, our classic logo was born by combining this aesthetic with the everyday gesture of taking a hearty sip of tea. beginning In 2011, a 20-year-old young man, frustrated by the lack of pure and great-tasting tea drinks on the market, decided to open a tea shop that served the kind of tea he loved. After over a year of preparation, he began thinking bigger: How can we make traditional tea cooler? Eventually, in his home kitchen, he developed a beta version of the first Cheese Tea — the salted cheese green tea. In May 2012, he opened the very first royaltea ( heytea’s predecessor ) in Jiangbianli, China. This marked the birthplace of the new style tea era. originator Before 2012, using cheap creamer powder, artificial flavors and coloring was the industry norm — almost no tea shops used natural ingredients. “You can’t make good milk tea without creamer powder,” many industry veterans claimed back then. Why not? Following our instincts, we chose a completely new path — using real tea, real milk, and natural ingredients to create the very first cheese tea. This cup of cheese tea rewrote industry history and marked the dawn of a new era in tea drinks. In the years that followed, starting from inspiration, we introduced a series of beloved products made with natural ingredients: Cloud Mango, Grape Boom, Supreme Brown Sugar Bobo Milk Tea, Mulberry Strawberry Boom, Kale Boost Tea, Cloud Coconut Blue... renaming Starting from a small alley, this cup of naturally crafted cheese tea quickly won customers’ hearts. Thanks to enthusiastic word-of-mouth recommendations, our stores began seeing spectacular lines. However, this popularity also attracted waves of counterfeiters. Copycat shops mushroomed nationwide, severely damaging our brand identity. To protect our brand, we made a decisive move: we completely rebranded from “royaltea” to the trademarked “HEYTEA”. This wasn’t just a name change — it was staying true to our roots while embarking on a new chapter. innovator Staying true to the original vision of our humble shop in Jiangbianli, China, we remain committed to natural ingredients and uncompromising quality. Driven by our own values, we strive to push the entire new style tea industry forward — toward a better future. We pledge full transparency and true quality in every handcrafted drink across all our stores. new style tea by inspiration Neither as stimulating as coffee nor as intoxicating as alcohol, we believe a good cup of tea has always had the power to bring calm and ease. From that little shop in Jiangbianli, China, we reimagined what tea could be in today’s world. With a desire to give new expression to this ancient Eastern tradition, we craft each cup with natural ingredients, offering a moment of quiet pleasure and mindful enjoyment in every sip. more information here→ brand story products stores partner recruitment English more information here→ brand story products stores partner recruitment English heytea heytea lab heytea teabar Tea Pavilion｜Infinitus Plaza Store, Hong Kong SAR, China On March 24, 2026, we opened another place to pause in the city at Infinitus Plaza, Hong Kong. With natural wood, textured stone, and greenery throughout, the space takes the form of a pavilion tea room. Inspired by the quiet atmosphere of a city park, it invites you to slow down for a moment whenever you pass by, and enjoy a cup of tea. Tea First｜Shamian DP Store, Guangzhou, China In our 11th year in Guangzhou, we finally arrived in Shamian. Located within Shamian Island’s century-old historic buildings, the space draws inspiration from Guangzhou’s morning tea culture. Bamboo weaving brings greenery indoors, creating a place to yum cha, relax, and enjoy tea the way locals have for generations. Tea Fossils｜Jing’an Joy City Store, Shanghai, China Inspired by archaeology, the store presents a future-facing tea culture site set in the year 3025. Bronze kettles, tea bowl fragments, and “tea fossils” reveal memories of old Shanghai tea stalls and hot-water houses. Visit the store and open the “Tea Fossil 3025 Archive” to discover tea-drinking clues from 2025. more information here→

We wanted somewhere that felt like St Kilda East: welcoming, a little rough around the edges, genuinely warm. The courtyard came first, really. That open sky and those yellow umbrellas set the tone for everything. The art came naturally. St Kilda East has always been a place where creativity lives on the walls, and we wanted that inside too. Every canvas is from a real artist. Every mural was painted by someone who left something of themselves here. The menu follows the same spirit: vegan-friendly, generous, colourful, and made for the whole table. If your dog falls asleep under the table and you end up staying two hours longer than you planned — that's exactly what we had in mind. brand story products stores partner recruitment English more information here→ brand story products stores partner recruitment English the inspiration of logo beginning originator renaming innovator new style tea by inspiration the inspiration of logo Inspired by the side-profile and simple lines seen on ancient coins, our classic logo was born by combining this aesthetic with the everyday gesture of taking a hearty sip of tea. beginning In 2011, a 20-year-old young man, frustrated by the lack of pure and great-tasting tea drinks on the market, decided to open a tea shop that served the kind of tea he loved. After over a year of preparation, he began thinking bigger: How can we make traditional tea cooler? Eventually, in his home kitchen, he developed a beta version of the first Cheese Tea — the salted cheese green tea. In May 2012, he opened the very first royaltea ( heytea’s predecessor ) in Jiangbianli, China. This marked the birthplace of the new style tea era. originator Before 2012, using cheap creamer powder, artificial flavors and coloring was the industry norm — almost no tea shops used natural ingredients. “You can’t make good milk tea without creamer powder,” many industry veterans claimed back then. Why not? Following our instincts, we chose a completely new path — using real tea, real milk, and natural ingredients to create the very first cheese tea. This cup of cheese tea rewrote industry history and marked the dawn of a new era in tea drinks. In the years that followed, starting from inspiration, we introduced a series of beloved products made with natural ingredients: Cloud Mango, Grape Boom, Supreme Brown Sugar Bobo Milk Tea, Mulberry Strawberry Boom, Kale Boost Tea, Cloud Coconut Blue... renaming Starting from a small alley, this cup of naturally crafted cheese tea quickly won customers’ hearts. Thanks to enthusiastic word-of-mouth recommendations, our stores began seeing spectacular lines. However, this popularity also attracted waves of counterfeiters. Copycat shops mushroomed nationwide, severely damaging our brand identity. To protect our brand, we made a decisive move: we completely rebranded from “royaltea” to the trademarked “HEYTEA”. This wasn’t just a name change — it was staying true to our roots while embarking on a new chapter. innovator Staying true to the original vision of our humble shop in Jiangbianli, China, we remain committed to natural ingredients and uncompromising quality. Driven by our own values, we strive to push the entire new style tea industry forward — toward a better future. We pledge full transparency and true quality in every handcrafted drink across all our stores. new style tea by inspiration Neither as stimulating as coffee nor as intoxicating as alcohol, we believe a good cup of tea has always had the power to bring calm and ease. From that little shop in Jiangbianli, China, we reimagined what tea could be in today’s world. With a desire to give new expression to this ancient Eastern tradition, we craft each cup with natural ingredients, offering a moment of quiet pleasure and mindful enjoyment in every sip. more information here→ brand story products stores partner recruitment English more information here→ brand story products stores partner recruitment English heytea heytea lab heytea teabar Tea Pavilion｜Infinitus Plaza Store, Hong Kong SAR, China On March 24, 2026, we opened another place to pause in the city at Infinitus Plaza, Hong Kong. With natural wood, textured stone, and greenery throughout, the space takes the form of a pavilion tea room. Inspired by the quiet atmosphere of a city park, it invites you to slow down for a moment whenever you pass by, and enjoy a cup of tea. Tea First｜Shamian DP Store, Guangzhou, China In our 11th year in Guangzhou, we finally arrived in Shamian. Located within Shamian Island’s century-old historic buildings, the space draws inspiration from Guangzhou’s morning tea culture. Bamboo weaving brings greenery indoors, creating a place to yum cha, relax, and enjoy tea the way locals have for generations. Tea Fossils｜Jing’an Joy City Store, Shanghai, China Inspired by archaeology, the store presents a future-facing tea culture site set in the year 3025. Bronze kettles, tea bowl fragments, and “tea fossils” reveal memories of old Shanghai tea stalls and hot-water houses. Visit the store and open the “Tea Fossil 3025 Archive” to discover tea-drinking clues from 2025. more information here→

Skip to Content Welcome Story Venues Contact Career 0 A slice of Japan, in Sydney Issho is all about simplicity, warmth, and the art of matcha. The moment you step inside, you’ll feel the effortless charm of a Tokyo café—minimalist, yet cosy. Our menu is built around premium matcha, from traditional whisked pours to modern creations that elevate the experience. Pair it with our signature soufflé pancakes or savoury bites, and let the flavours (and the atmosphere) transport you. Visual Identities & Site Credits: The Nontouch Skip to Content Welcome Story Venues Contact Career 0 Story behind the flavours Siam Palette is the passion project of owners, On & Penny, from Thailand who turned their love for food into something bigger. Growing up with Thai cuisine, we wanted to share those vibes with the world—but with a modern twist that keeps things fresh and fun. Not just about restaurants, We’re about creating an experience Siam Palette Group is a hospitality collective born from the boldness of Siam — a name that honours our Thai roots — and the belief that flavours, like colours, are meant to be explored, layered, and reimagined. The word “Palette” represents more than just artistry — it reflects our passion for creating experiences that are multi-sensory, multi-cultural, and unforgettable. In English, “palette” is the artist’s tool for mixing colours. In food, it echoes the palate, the individual’s taste. For us, it means curating bold, beautiful dining experiences that speak to many tastes at once. By combining the spirit of Siam with the canvas of flavour, we’ve built a group of brands that each offer their own twist — always Asian at heart, but never afraid to explore new shades. From flaky Thai-inspired croissants, to wagyu sandos with fire-kissed sauces, to matcha desserts soft as a whisper — each venue is its own expression. But all share the DNA of Asian fusion done thoughtfully, with a nod to tradition and a wink to what’s next.
