STITCH COFFEE was born of an idea that coffee doesn’t need to be a standalone - it can be mixed together. We realised at an early stage that the art of blending coffee is the same as tailoring a piece of cloth. As a result, we stitched together origins with different flavours to bring forward the ultimate cup characteristics for everyone to enjoy. Daring, bold and unconventional, we aim to break the mould and bring specialty coffee to all. Sharing this craft and its fine coffee products is all for your enjoyment at home and beyond. We do this by creating connections with our suppliers and consumers from the very beginning of the coffee supply chain to the very end of the consumption process. With a focus on ensuring that consumers know about and have transparency about the entire coffee journey. We share information so that every participant in the coffee process succeeds, and our industry continues to thrive for decades to come. Innovation is one of our passions, bringing you coffee products that enable special moments shared over coffee. And we want this to happen anywhere and whenever, be it from our Broadway flagship store, in the comfort of your home or even when you are on the go! Bringing specialty coffee into every part of what we do starts with us ensuring that our wholesale customers (cafes and retailers) are knowledgeable through our coaching-style relationship. This helps to upskill them so that their offerings to you are of the highest level with a perfect cup of coffee, no matter the brewing method. We have become well known within our industry as a Specialty Coffee Roaster that is bold, fun and quality focused. We rotate single origins from all over the globe in an effort to bring variety and share knowledge with our consumers, as a platform to promote the work of coffee farmers across the continents. No favourites and no specialisation of region, but a focus on the farmer / producer – no matter where they were located. This is what makes up our community and feeds into our why, why we do what we do, why we exist. From pickers, farmers to roasters and coffee addicts, we are here to bring people together through coffee. “WE ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT CREATING UNIQUE, DELICIOUS COFFEE FROM AROUND THE WORLD AND TO CONNECT THESE WITH OUR CONSUMERS AS WE CELEBRATE THE WORK OF COFFEE PRODUCERS AND ALL THOSE ACROSS THE COFFEE JOURNEY. COFFEE TO US, IS A CRAFT ONLY POSSIBLE BY BRINGING COMMUNITIES TOGETHER.” OUR ORIGIN STORY At STITCH COFFEE we believe that coffee is much like a tapestry - it is a weaving of origins and flavours to create a delicious cup. Nawar Adra, owner and founder of STITCH COFFEE, had humble beginnings working as a barista in the iconic Western Sydney Suburbs cafe Circa Espresso. This is where Nawar started his roasting journey when Circa purchased their very own Probat P5 roaster for in-house production. During his time there, the focus was only on single origin coffees. However, Nawar gradually realised there was an artistry within the blending of origins. This merging of origins created a cup with distinct complexity, structure, and balance. The concept gave birth to STITCH COFFEE. We opened the doors to our roastery in 2015 and haven’t looked back. Today we are a company dedicated to creating connections through coffee, from green bean importers, to everyday coffee drinkers and everyone in between. Part of our offering goes beyond our coffee. It includes assisting cafes in up-skilling their baristas and teams, training them on extracting the perfect espresso and brew a delicious pour-over. Our love for coffee is fed by the daily home brewers and the cafes that serve our coffee, which is why education and knowledge sharing is so important for us. We will continue to source coffee ethically from around the world and ensure that we have the ability to communicate this with our community. We are continuously evolving our buying practises and fostering relationships with importers and farmers to ensure a healthy future for coffee. DIVERSITY & INCLUSIVITY It all starts with the heart of our company: our team. Our team members come from many countries and cultures, and that allows us to have a wide range of perspectives. Many points of view that come together and are stitched together into one big family. We believe in everyone’s potential to succeed by being a supportive workplace and setting our team up for success, just as we do with our business goals. SUSTAINABILITY & ETHICAL SOURCING STITCH COFFEE strive to forge a strong and long-lasting relationship with green bean importers who value sustainability as much as we do. We believe in empowering the entire supply chain in this industry and together make it better. Read more about our sustainability practices here. We are a highly visual brand, our packaging looks pretty nice (if we do say so ourselves) and we also want to be kind to our world. For the last few years we have endeavoured to move towards making our packaging recyclable and reduce waste all-round. We are proud to say we are good and clean for our planet, presenting new ways to package coffee that are different to other coffee products whilst maintaining the quality of the cup you brew COMMUNITY & COLLABORATION The coffee community is our why. From pickers, farmers to roasters and coffee addicts, we are here to bring people together through coffee. The ideology that we operate on is - If you want to go fast, go alone. If you want to go far, go together (African proverb). When one part of our community succeeds, we all do. We advocate on behalf of our fellow roasters to help them access great quality green beans. This is the power of co-roasting! Our co-roasting initiatives are powered by our sister BRAND ECRE. Find out more about it here. We support our wholesale customers with continuous training, connection to suppliers and business advice. We believe we only succeed when we stick together – or stitch together. GROWTH & EXPANSION We are bold, we are trailblazers, we thrive off being daring, unconventional and pushing boundaries. Never afraid to go big, go first and go where others don’t venture. ‘First movers’ is our favourite combo of words and although we are not always the first, we are a leader in the coffee industry. We innovate in a wide range of products and offer something for all types of coffee lovers. Innovation never ends as we don’t want to miss a beat to continually move forward, to better ourselves, learn and grow, whilst making it accessible to the specialty coffee industry. View Menu FAQ What is Gyukatsu? A Japanese classic from Kyoto. Gyukatsu Kyoto Katsugyu began in Kyoto with a simple idea: to share the deliciousness of Gyukatsu with the world. Our famous beef cutlet is quickly fried at high temperature to preserve the natural flavour of the meat. Crispy on the outside and medium-rare on the inside, it is served with a variety of sauces and condiments so every bite can be enjoyed in different ways. Our Signature Dishes While Gyukatsu is our signature dish, our menu also includes seafood and chicken options so everyone at the table can enjoy the experience together. Born in Kyoto, Gyukatsu Kyoto Katsugyu continues to follow the culinary philosophy that defines Kyoto cuisine: simplicity, precision, and respect for ingredients. The Craft Behind Every Cutlet Premium beef is coated in delicate breadcrumbs and quickly fried at high temperature. This technique seals in the natural flavour of the meat while creating the signature contrast that defines Gyukatsu. A crisp golden crust. A tender, medium-rare centre. You finish the doness your way. Unlike traditional cutlets that are fully cooked before serving, Gyukatsu is designed to preserve the natural character of the beef, allowing its flavour and texture to remain the focus. Every cutlet is prepared with care, reflecting the Japanese belief that even the simplest dishes deserve mastery. As the brand expands globally, the spirit of Kyoto remains at its heart. Quiet dedication. Attention to detail. And the pursuit of flavour that feels both simple and extraordinary. text: RESERVATION RESERVATION HomeAboutMenuNewsContactRESERVATION EXPERIENCE ELEVATED KOREAN GASTRONOMY AT ALLTA Allta continues its pursuit of redefining modern Korean cuisine in Sydney. Led by Chef Jung-Su Chang, our team is dedicated to creating lasting impressions while shaping the evolving narrative of Korean dining culture in Sydney. With our recent relocation, Allta unveils a new 11-course menu — a refined journey that draws from Chef Jung-Su’s experience, weaving time-honoured Korean traditions and techniques into a contemporary gastronomic expression. OUR STORY Allta comes from the Korean word for 'Very right' which is how we aim to deliver elevated Korean Gastronomy. A chance encounter brought restaurateurs Jangho and Sunyoung Kim in touch with one of Korea’s rising talents, Chef Jung-su Chang, and after the successful launch, of Funda (A Lot of Fun), the team wanted to present a new dimension to Korean cuisine in Sydney’s eclectic dining scene. Drawing on Chef Jung-su’s experience in Michelin starred institutions around Seoul, Allta embodies the pinnacle of Korean tradition and technique and aims to bring this practice into a modern dining experience. This resulted in being awarded two hats by Good Food Guide for two consecutive years. Come check out Tokyo Lamington & the Bakery in Marrickville Frequently Asked Questions FAQ Which country invented lamingtons Australia invented the lamington. While there's some friendly rivalry with New Zealand over various food origins, the lamington is widely acknowledged as an Australian creation. What makes a lamington a lamington? Three essential elements define a lamington: sponge cake, chocolate coating, and a layer of desiccated coconut. This combination of textures and flavours - the soft cake, smooth chocolate, and crispy coconut - is what makes a lamington a lamington. We at Tokyo Lamington pushes the boundaries of a lamington with our creations. Is there egg in your lamington? Yes, our lamingtons contain cooked pasteurised eggs as they provide structure and lightness to our sponge cake. Saying that, our vegan lamington is egg-free. Is there gelatin in your lamington? Some of our lamington contains halal gelatin in the cream, with the exception of our vegan lamington. How long can you keep lamingtons? Our lamingtons are made with fresh ingredients, they can be kept refrigerated for up to 2 days, of course the sooner you eat them the better. Home Gifting Corporate Gifting Gift cards Lookbook Collaborations Contact About Order now Our journey so far From Tokyo to Sydney Scene: Cool autumn evening on a park bench after few too many highballs from a business meeting just before then. The conversation started like this, Eddie: I'm surprised how well lamingtons are selling in the cafe in Tokyo. Min: Really? Imagine doing a shop that sells only lamingtons in Tokyo, how troll is that. Eddie: You laugh, it might actually work. Min: LOL! We actually did a draft concept in the hotel the very same night, though details were a little blurry, we laughed and passed out soon after. It was about the same time when covid struck and change our lives. At the usher of the Australian government, we canned our plans for Tokyo and came back to Sydney. With nothing much going on, we thought it would be good to give Tokyo Lamington a try in Australia. Little did we know that it would become what it is today. We spent our time in hospitality enough to know how hard it is. We vowed to create a better space for the team and ourselves. Our goal was not just to create great lamingtons, but to build a business that reflected our values of sustainability, inclusivity, and diversity. We're proud to have built a team that celebrates diversity and prioritizes staff well-being. We know that an inclusive and supportive workplace is essential to creating a strong and resilient team, and we're committed to fostering a work environment where everyone feels valued and respected. We believe that food should be delicious, but it should also be responsible and sustainable. That's why we carefully source our ingredients from local suppliers and prioritise using sustainable practices in everything we do, like recycled and compostable packaging, so you can enjoy our cakes and coffee guilt-free. What started off as joke on a park bench in Tokyo is now a little bakery in Sydney and Melbourne run by this little family. STITCH COFFEE was born of an idea that coffee doesn’t need to be a standalone - it can be mixed together. We realised at an early stage that the art of blending coffee is the same as tailoring a piece of cloth. As a result, we stitched together origins with different flavours to bring forward the ultimate cup characteristics for everyone to enjoy. Daring, bold and unconventional, we aim to break the mould and bring specialty coffee to all. Sharing this craft and its fine coffee products is all for your enjoyment at home and beyond. We do this by creating connections with our suppliers and consumers from the very beginning of the coffee supply chain to the very end of the consumption process. With a focus on ensuring that consumers know about and have transparency about the entire coffee journey. We share information so that every participant in the coffee process succeeds, and our industry continues to thrive for decades to come. Innovation is one of our passions, bringing you coffee products that enable special moments shared over coffee. And we want this to happen anywhere and whenever, be it from our Broadway flagship store, in the comfort of your home or even when you are on the go! Bringing specialty coffee into every part of what we do starts with us ensuring that our wholesale customers (cafes and retailers) are knowledgeable through our coaching-style relationship. This helps to upskill them so that their offerings to you are of the highest level with a perfect cup of coffee, no matter the brewing method. We have become well known within our industry as a Specialty Coffee Roaster that is bold, fun and quality focused. We rotate single origins from all over the globe in an effort to bring variety and share knowledge with our consumers, as a platform to promote the work of coffee farmers across the continents. No favourites and no specialisation of region, but a focus on the farmer / producer – no matter where they were located. This is what makes up our community and feeds into our why, why we do what we do, why we exist. From pickers, farmers to roasters and coffee addicts, we are here to bring people together through coffee. “WE ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT CREATING UNIQUE, DELICIOUS COFFEE FROM AROUND THE WORLD AND TO CONNECT THESE WITH OUR CONSUMERS AS WE CELEBRATE THE WORK OF COFFEE PRODUCERS AND ALL THOSE ACROSS THE COFFEE JOURNEY. COFFEE TO US, IS A CRAFT ONLY POSSIBLE BY BRINGING COMMUNITIES TOGETHER.” OUR ORIGIN STORY At STITCH COFFEE we believe that coffee is much like a tapestry - it is a weaving of origins and flavours to create a delicious cup. Nawar Adra, owner and founder of STITCH COFFEE, had humble beginnings working as a barista in the iconic Western Sydney Suburbs cafe Circa Espresso. This is where Nawar started his roasting journey when Circa purchased their very own Probat P5 roaster for in-house production. During his time there, the focus was only on single origin coffees. However, Nawar gradually realised there was an artistry within the blending of origins. This merging of origins created a cup with distinct complexity, structure, and balance. The concept gave birth to STITCH COFFEE. We opened the doors to our roastery in 2015 and haven’t looked back. Today we are a company dedicated to creating connections through coffee, from green bean importers, to everyday coffee drinkers and everyone in between. Part of our offering goes beyond our coffee. It includes assisting cafes in up-skilling their baristas and teams, training them on extracting the perfect espresso and brew a delicious pour-over. Our love for coffee is fed by the daily home brewers and the cafes that serve our coffee, which is why education and knowledge sharing is so important for us. We will continue to source coffee ethically from around the world and ensure that we have the ability to communicate this with our community. We are continuously evolving our buying practises and fostering relationships with importers and farmers to ensure a healthy future for coffee. DIVERSITY & INCLUSIVITY It all starts with the heart of our company: our team. Our team members come from many countries and cultures, and that allows us to have a wide range of perspectives. Many points of view that come together and are stitched together into one big family. We believe in everyone’s potential to succeed by being a supportive workplace and setting our team up for success, just as we do with our business goals. SUSTAINABILITY & ETHICAL SOURCING STITCH COFFEE strive to forge a strong and long-lasting relationship with green bean importers who value sustainability as much as we do. We believe in empowering the entire supply chain in this industry and together make it better. Read more about our sustainability practices here. We are a highly visual brand, our packaging looks pretty nice (if we do say so ourselves) and we also want to be kind to our world. For the last few years we have endeavoured to move towards making our packaging recyclable and reduce waste all-round. We are proud to say we are good and clean for our planet, presenting new ways to package coffee that are different to other coffee products whilst maintaining the quality of the cup you brew COMMUNITY & COLLABORATION The coffee community is our why. From pickers, farmers to roasters and coffee addicts, we are here to bring people together through coffee. The ideology that we operate on is - If you want to go fast, go alone. If you want to go far, go together (African proverb). When one part of our community succeeds, we all do. We advocate on behalf of our fellow roasters to help them access great quality green beans. This is the power of co-roasting! Our co-roasting initiatives are powered by our sister BRAND ECRE. Find out more about it here. We support our wholesale customers with continuous training, connection to suppliers and business advice. We believe we only succeed when we stick together – or stitch together. GROWTH & EXPANSION We are bold, we are trailblazers, we thrive off being daring, unconventional and pushing boundaries. Never afraid to go big, go first and go where others don’t venture. ‘First movers’ is our favourite combo of words and although we are not always the first, we are a leader in the coffee industry. We innovate in a wide range of products and offer something for all types of coffee lovers. Innovation never ends as we don’t want to miss a beat to continually move forward, to better ourselves, learn and grow, whilst making it accessible to the specialty coffee industry. Every dish is made with care. Small space. Big heart. Reservations strongly recommended. ------------------------- RESERVATIONS Join us for dining Seating is limited. BOOK A TABLE ONLINE CALL 02 8354 0901 Reserve a table Menu Our Story Contact Gift cards MENU LUNCH DINNER Choose De Night (Tuesday) SET MENU DRINK TAKE AWAY My Zakaya Reserve a table Menu Our Story Contact Gift cards © 2023 MyZakaya Reserve a table Menu Our Story Contact Gift cards MEET NOBU MARUYAMA The Heart Behind My Zakaya Nobu Maruyama is a dedicated chef with a lifelong love for cooking. Born and raised in Japan, he moved to Australia in 2007, driven by a desire to explore new culinary traditions and push himself beyond familiar boundaries. He worked his way through some of Sydney’s most respected restaurants, from the French fine dining at Blancharu and Bistro Moncur, to leading kitchens at innovative Asian fusion spots like Bar H Dining and Kuro Dining. These experiences shaped not only his skills, but also his philosophy that great food is about more than recipes. It’s about care, patience, and understanding where flavours come from. At My Zakaya, Nobu brings everything full circle. His cooking is grounded in Japanese tradition, using techniques like fermentation, ageing, and dashi from scratch, while drawing inspiration from the wider world. Every dish reflects his passion for deep, natural umami flavours, seasonal ingredients, and the quiet details that make a meal feel special. My Zakaya is Nobu’s way of sharing what he loves, thoughtful, honest food made with heart. It's a place where craftsmanship meets comfort, and where every dish has a story to tell. KINTSUGI JOURNEY Beauty in Broken Things What happens when a plate breaks? For many, it's the end, a reason to discard, replace, and move on. But at My Zakaya, it's just the beginning of a new story. In our kitchen, we don’t believe in throwing things away, especially not something made with care and artistry. When a plate breaks, we don’t see damage. We see a potential. We see a beauty waiting to be revealed. That’s why we began practicing Kintsugi, the centuries old Japanese art of repairing broken pottery with lacquer mixed with gold powder. Rather than hiding cracks, Kintsugi highlights them, honouring the history of an object and celebrating its imperfections as part of its charm. Kaori Maruyama began practicing Kintsugi to embrace Japanese tradition, sustainability, and the quiet beauty of resilience. Every golden seam tells a story of care, craftsmanship, and renewal. Today, we proudly serve dishes on these Kintsugi plates, each one holding more than just food. It holds meaning. We share a piece of culture, a story of revival, and a glimpse of Japan’s deep rooted spirit through every plate we serve.

brand story products stores partner recruitment English more information here→ brand story products stores partner recruitment English the inspiration of logo beginning originator renaming innovator new style tea by inspiration the inspiration of logo Inspired by the side-profile and simple lines seen on ancient coins, our classic logo was born by combining this aesthetic with the everyday gesture of taking a hearty sip of tea. beginning In 2011, a 20-year-old young man, frustrated by the lack of pure and great-tasting tea drinks on the market, decided to open a tea shop that served the kind of tea he loved. After over a year of preparation, he began thinking bigger: How can we make traditional tea cooler? Eventually, in his home kitchen, he developed a beta version of the first Cheese Tea — the salted cheese green tea. In May 2012, he opened the very first royaltea ( heytea’s predecessor ) in Jiangbianli, China. This marked the birthplace of the new style tea era. originator Before 2012, using cheap creamer powder, artificial flavors and coloring was the industry norm — almost no tea shops used natural ingredients. “You can’t make good milk tea without creamer powder,” many industry veterans claimed back then. Why not? Following our instincts, we chose a completely new path — using real tea, real milk, and natural ingredients to create the very first cheese tea. This cup of cheese tea rewrote industry history and marked the dawn of a new era in tea drinks. In the years that followed, starting from inspiration, we introduced a series of beloved products made with natural ingredients: Cloud Mango, Grape Boom, Supreme Brown Sugar Bobo Milk Tea, Mulberry Strawberry Boom, Kale Boost Tea, Cloud Coconut Blue... renaming Starting from a small alley, this cup of naturally crafted cheese tea quickly won customers’ hearts. Thanks to enthusiastic word-of-mouth recommendations, our stores began seeing spectacular lines. However, this popularity also attracted waves of counterfeiters. Copycat shops mushroomed nationwide, severely damaging our brand identity. To protect our brand, we made a decisive move: we completely rebranded from “royaltea” to the trademarked “HEYTEA”. This wasn’t just a name change — it was staying true to our roots while embarking on a new chapter. innovator Staying true to the original vision of our humble shop in Jiangbianli, China, we remain committed to natural ingredients and uncompromising quality. Driven by our own values, we strive to push the entire new style tea industry forward — toward a better future. We pledge full transparency and true quality in every handcrafted drink across all our stores. new style tea by inspiration Neither as stimulating as coffee nor as intoxicating as alcohol, we believe a good cup of tea has always had the power to bring calm and ease. From that little shop in Jiangbianli, China, we reimagined what tea could be in today’s world. Skip to Content About Menus Locations Franchise Careers Our Story ABOUT US The main star of Gram Cafe & Pancakes is the Premium Soufflé Pancakes: three tiers of pillow-like puffs served with fresh whipped cream, butter and maple syrup. Get ready to embark on a fluffy adventure that will make your taste buds dance with joy. GALLERY Our Secret The secret to the pancakes ultra-light, fluffy structure is all in the technique: the mostly egg-white batter (hence soufflé) is whipped to peak volume, then steamed in rounds under metal domes. Gram is the ultimate pancake experience making it the perfect choice for anywhere between breakfast to dessert. Try Our Iced Matcha At Cafe C&M, coffee is part of what we do every day. From smooth flat whites to rich long blacks made with premium Campos Coffee, our cafes are built around great coffee, good food, and those familiar local moments that keep people coming back. But every now and then, you might feel like changing things up. Maybe it’s a warm afternoon and you’ve already had your morning coffee. Maybe you’re after something lighter and more refreshing. Or perhaps you’re simply curious about trying something new. That’s where our iced matcha Sydney locals have embraced comes in. What Is Matcha? Matcha is a finely ground green tea powder that’s been enjoyed in Japan for centuries. Unlike regular green tea where the leaves are brewed and removed, matcha uses the whole leaf, creating a drink with richer flavour, that vibrant green colour, and a naturally smooth energy boost. Good matcha has a very distinctive taste. Slightly earthy, lightly sweet, and incredibly refreshing when served over ice. It’s simple, clean, and surprisingly satisfying—which is exactly why our iced matcha Sydney cafes serve has become such a hit. Why Iced Matcha Sydney Cafes Serve Has Become So Popular Over the last few years, iced matcha has become one of Sydney’s most requested cafe drinks, and it’s easy to understand why. Many people love matcha because it feels lighter than coffee while still giving that energising lift during the day. Others enjoy the smoother flavour and creamy texture, especially when paired with oat, almond, or soy milk. “I used to be strictly a coffee person,” says Emma, a regular at our Rushcutters Bay location. “But on warmer days, the Iced Matcha with oat milk has become my go-to. It’s refreshing without being too sweet, and I love that I can still get that energy boost without feeling wired.” And for some people, it’s simply about variety. Even our most dedicated coffee lovers enjoy having something different every now and then. The Cafe C&M Iced Matcha When it comes to iced matcha Sydney offers, ours is made with premium matcha powder, your choice of milk, and ice, blended into a smooth and balanced drink that’s refreshing without being overly sweet. Our baristas at the Rushcutters Bay cafe has noticed the shift. “We’re making just as many Iced Matchas as we are flat whites on warm afternoons,” they say. “People love having the option, and once they try it, they’re usually back for it regularly.” It’s the kind of drink that works any time of day. Morning catch-ups, post-gym refreshment, afternoon cafe stops, weekend brunches with friends. Whether you already love matcha or you’re trying it for the first time, our version is approachable, creamy, and easy to enjoy. Choose Your Milk Like our coffee menu, our iced matcha Sydney regulars order can be customised to suit your preference, and the milk you choose genuinely makes a difference to the final drink. Regular Milk creates a classic, creamy matcha with a fuller body. It’s smooth, slightly sweet, and lets the earthy matcha flavour come through without competing with it. If you’re trying matcha for the first time, regular milk is a safe, familiar starting point. Oat Milk has become one of our most popular choices for Iced Matcha. It’s naturally creamy with a subtle sweetness that complements matcha beautifully. The texture is smooth and rich without feeling heavy, and it froths up nicely when blended. Many of our regulars swear by oat milk for matcha—it just works. Bonsoy brings a clean, slightly nutty flavour that pairs really well with the grassy notes in matcha. It’s lighter than oat milk but still creamy, and it doesn’t overpower the tea. If you prefer a more delicate, refined taste, Bonsoy is an excellent choice. Almond Milk is the lightest option we offer. It has a gentle, nutty undertone and creates a thinner, more refreshing drink. Perfect for warm Sydney days when you want something cooling and not too rich. Some customers love how the almond flavour adds another layer to the matcha. Coconut Milk adds a tropical twist. It’s creamy with a subtle coconut flavour that creates quite a different drink—slightly sweeter and more indulgent. If you enjoy coconut, this pairing is lovely, though it does change the traditional matcha profile a bit more than the other options. Not sure which to try? Ask our baristas. They’ve made hundreds of these and can guide you based on what you normally enjoy. Pairs Beautifully With Breakfast or a Bagel One of the reasons customers love our iced matcha Sydney locations serve is how well it pairs with food, particularly our bagels and breakfast menu. The refreshing, earthy notes of matcha work beautifully alongside richer breakfast flavours. Try it with our Bacon & Egg Bagel for a satisfying contrast—the smooth, creamy matcha balances out the savoury bacon and melted cheese perfectly. If you’re after something lighter, our Smoked Salmon Bagel with cream cheese, capers, and fresh dill pairs wonderfully with the clean, green taste of matcha. For our vegetarian regulars, the Grilled Halloumi Bagel is an excellent match. The salty, grilled halloumi and fresh vegetables complement the subtle sweetness of the matcha without overwhelming it. And if you’re in the mood for something sweet, our banana bread is a customer favourite alongside Iced Matcha. The warm spices in the bread and the creamy matcha create a lovely mid-morning combination that feels indulgent without being heavy. Whether you’re grabbing a quick breakfast on the way to work or settling in for a proper weekend brunch, our Iced Matcha fits right in with whatever you’re having. It’s refreshing, balanced, and easy to enjoy with all your usual cafe favourites. Available at All Cafe C&M Locations You’ll find our Iced Matcha available year-round across all Cafe C&M locations in Bondi, Darlinghurst, Rushcutters Bay, Peakhurst, and Kirrawee. So next time you feel like something different from your usual coffee order, give our iced matcha Sydney locals love a try. You might just discover a new favourite. Whether you’re settling in for a quiet dinner, a date, or one last bite on your way home, RND offers Bondi’s take on an izakaya — understated, warm and made for the hours after dark. Before Harry’s opened its doors, Raw Bar was already part of Bondi’s heartbeat. Established in 1995, it was the first Japanese restaurant in Sydney’s East — serving up ultra-fresh sushi and sashimi long before Bondi became the dining hub it is today. Raw Bar quickly became a local institution, known for its relaxed charm, familiar faces and the occasional celebrity sighting, all without the pressure to dress up. Two years later, Harry’s Espresso joined the neighbourhood — a humble café on Wairoa Avenue built on a simple idea: to create a place where friends, family and neighbours could meet, relax and enjoy good food and coffee. Fast forward to 2015, and the laundromat next door became ours. We took it over, breathed new life into it and shaped it into what is now Harry’s Bondi — still anchored by community, still steeped in the bonds of local friends and families. From there, we followed the tide of curiosity, opportunity and heart — and gradually built our family of venues across Bondi. From there, we followed the tide of curiosity, opportunity and heart — and gradually built our family of venues across Bondi. Next came RND (Raw Next Door) — Harry’s by day, transforming into RND by night. When the lights dim, the familiar cafe becomes an izakaya-style restaurant and bar where Bondi locals meet for drinks, bites and good times. Then came Lulu — a pan-Asian dining venue inspired by flavours from Japan, Korea, Thailand, Vietnam and beyond. Thought of as Raw Bar’s spicy little sister, Lulu is full of personality, sass and flavour. And most recently, the sweetest addition of all: Luca & Luca — a tiny gelato shop inspired by old-school European tradition, handcrafted with care and made to be lingered over. Together, these five venues form our Harry’s Family; each distinct in style yet united in spirit. Whether you’re popping in for coffee at Harry’s, gathering for dinner at Lulu, sipping sake at Raw Bar, heading out for drinks at RND or grabbing a gelato at Luca & Luca — community is at the heart of it all. Thank you to everyone for being a part of our story. I started this journey because I believed in the warmth of Bondi, the vibrancy of hospitality and the joy of sharing good food and drink with good people. Each venue has its own personality, its own rhythm — but the heart behind it all remains the same: welcome in, stay a while, feel at home. Mama Anita and her son Nir making frozen treats, figuring things out as they went. People noticed. And then they kept coming back for more. More than 20 years later, that same spirit still shows up in every colorful tray, generous topping, and the first bite that makes you pause for a second. BLOG The art of toppings: how Anita creates the perfect scoop experience March 15, 2026 Every scoop starts ahead of the game at Anita. The gelato is crafted by hand, churned fresh in-store, and offered in a dazzling rotation of over 150 flavors. Then come the toppings, turning each perfect scoop into a celebration. Suddenly, your gelato is not just creamy or cold, but it also crackles, sparkles, and shows off a personality all of its own. 🍦 BLOG Gelato Instagram Tips: How to Capture the Perfect Scoop February 28, 2026 You know that moment when your gelato arrives and you pause for a second before eating it? Not on purpose, just… it looks too good to eat! The scoop holds its shape well and the ridges are soft but defined, and the color feels almost too clean to be real. Someone at the table says “wait, don’t touch it yet,” and suddenly phones are out. That’s really all this is. Catching that moment before it melts into something else. An algorithm is a sequence — a pattern that, when followed with care, creates something meaningful. That idea resonated deeply with us. we find patterns in the lives of our customers and we obsess over them, we memorise their name, their preference, their story so everytime they come back, they always find their rhythm. AS SEEN ON FINDING OUR RHYTHM Algorithm isn’t just a café, it’s a community. We believe great coffee and amazing food are not enough. We have to put love into everything we do so it overflows. Customers can feel when we genuinely serve them. “service” and “personal touch” are very important to us. When people visit our cafes, we greet them with a warm welcome and deliver the best menu and interaction possible. MORE THAN A FULL-SERVICE CAFE We treat each team member like our own family, and you can feel they’re happy to be here. Everything starts from within. When they’re happy to work, it overflows to our customers. ​ From the beginning, our heart in starting Algorithm has been to see people grow. We don’t want our team members to simply come to work to earn money — we want to help build their lives. WANT TO SHARE YOUR EXPERIENCE? Try Our Iced Matcha At Cafe C&M, coffee is part of what we do every day. From smooth flat whites to rich long blacks made with premium Campos Coffee, our cafes are built around great coffee, good food, and those familiar local moments that keep people coming back. But every now and then, you might feel like changing things up. Maybe it’s a warm afternoon and you’ve already had your morning coffee. Maybe you’re after something lighter and more refreshing. Or perhaps you’re simply curious about trying something new. That’s where our iced matcha Sydney locals have embraced comes in. What Is Matcha? Matcha is a finely ground green tea powder that’s been enjoyed in Japan for centuries. Unlike regular green tea where the leaves are brewed and removed, matcha uses the whole leaf, creating a drink with richer flavour, that vibrant green colour, and a naturally smooth energy boost. Good matcha has a very distinctive taste. Slightly earthy, lightly sweet, and incredibly refreshing when served over ice. It’s simple, clean, and surprisingly satisfying—which is exactly why our iced matcha Sydney cafes serve has become such a hit. Why Iced Matcha Sydney Cafes Serve Has Become So Popular Over the last few years, iced matcha has become one of Sydney’s most requested cafe drinks, and it’s easy to understand why. Many people love matcha because it feels lighter than coffee while still giving that energising lift during the day. Others enjoy the smoother flavour and creamy texture, especially when paired with oat, almond, or soy milk. “I used to be strictly a coffee person,” says Emma, a regular at our Rushcutters Bay location. “But on warmer days, the Iced Matcha with oat milk has become my go-to. It’s refreshing without being too sweet, and I love that I can still get that energy boost without feeling wired.” And for some people, it’s simply about variety. Even our most dedicated coffee lovers enjoy having something different every now and then. The Cafe C&M Iced Matcha When it comes to iced matcha Sydney offers, ours is made with premium matcha powder, your choice of milk, and ice, blended into a smooth and balanced drink that’s refreshing without being overly sweet. Our baristas at the Rushcutters Bay cafe has noticed the shift. “We’re making just as many Iced Matchas as we are flat whites on warm afternoons,” they say. “People love having the option, and once they try it, they’re usually back for it regularly.” It’s the kind of drink that works any time of day. Morning catch-ups, post-gym refreshment, afternoon cafe stops, weekend brunches with friends. Whether you already love matcha or you’re trying it for the first time, our version is approachable, creamy, and easy to enjoy. Choose Your Milk Like our coffee menu, our iced matcha Sydney regulars order can be customised to suit your preference, and the milk you choose genuinely makes a difference to the final drink. Regular Milk creates a classic, creamy matcha with a fuller body. It’s smooth, slightly sweet, and lets the earthy matcha flavour come through without competing with it. If you’re trying matcha for the first time, regular milk is a safe, familiar starting point. Oat Milk has become one of our most popular choices for Iced Matcha. It’s naturally creamy with a subtle sweetness that complements matcha beautifully. The texture is smooth and rich without feeling heavy, and it froths up nicely when blended. Many of our regulars swear by oat milk for matcha—it just works. Bonsoy brings a clean, slightly nutty flavour that pairs really well with the grassy notes in matcha. It’s lighter than oat milk but still creamy, and it doesn’t overpower the tea. If you prefer a more delicate, refined taste, Bonsoy is an excellent choice. Almond Milk is the lightest option we offer. It has a gentle, nutty undertone and creates a thinner, more refreshing drink. Perfect for warm Sydney days when you want something cooling and not too rich. Some customers love how the almond flavour adds another layer to the matcha. Coconut Milk adds a tropical twist. It’s creamy with a subtle coconut flavour that creates quite a different drink—slightly sweeter and more indulgent. If you enjoy coconut, this pairing is lovely, though it does change the traditional matcha profile a bit more than the other options. Not sure which to try? Ask our baristas. They’ve made hundreds of these and can guide you based on what you normally enjoy. Pairs Beautifully With Breakfast or a Bagel One of the reasons customers love our iced matcha Sydney locations serve is how well it pairs with food, particularly our bagels and breakfast menu. The refreshing, earthy notes of matcha work beautifully alongside richer breakfast flavours. Try it with our Bacon & Egg Bagel for a satisfying contrast—the smooth, creamy matcha balances out the savoury bacon and melted cheese perfectly. If you’re after something lighter, our Smoked Salmon Bagel with cream cheese, capers, and fresh dill pairs wonderfully with the clean, green taste of matcha. For our vegetarian regulars, the Grilled Halloumi Bagel is an excellent match. The salty, grilled halloumi and fresh vegetables complement the subtle sweetness of the matcha without overwhelming it. And if you’re in the mood for something sweet, our banana bread is a customer favourite alongside Iced Matcha. The warm spices in the bread and the creamy matcha create a lovely mid-morning combination that feels indulgent without being heavy. Whether you’re grabbing a quick breakfast on the way to work or settling in for a proper weekend brunch, our Iced Matcha fits right in with whatever you’re having. It’s refreshing, balanced, and easy to enjoy with all your usual cafe favourites. Available at All Cafe C&M Locations You’ll find our Iced Matcha available year-round across all Cafe C&M locations in Bondi, Darlinghurst, Rushcutters Bay, Peakhurst, and Kirrawee. So next time you feel like something different from your usual coffee order, give our iced matcha Sydney locals love a try. You might just discover a new favourite. On October 11, 2017, she opened JUAN (寿庵), a specialty rice bowls and tea shop. Maintaining traditional flavors while leveraging her experience as a designer, she presents beautifully crafted rice bowl dishes. With a focus on quality, the restaurant emphasizes the use of carefully selected ingredients, including those sourced from Japan, premium brand pork, Wagyu beef and local vegetables. Prioritizing customer satisfaction and smiles, JUAN (寿庵) strives to provide consistent quality and service. The name "JUAN (寿庵)" translates to "House of Longevity" in Japanese, where "寿 (ju)" symbolizes blessings and happiness, while "庵 (an)" refers to a small dwelling or hut where wishes for longevity and happiness reside. Offering a sense of fun and occasion, Executive Chef Nobuyuki Ura from hatted CBD restaurant sushi e will oversee this modern take on one’s of Australian’s favourite cuisines, presiding over three distinct offerings. The first, inside the venue’s main area, is our lounge restaurant which reflects Western tastes by blending a sushi menu with dishes drawn from across the Japanese spectrum. Our menu includes braised and steamed dishes from the kitchen, Japanese street food as well as seafood, meat and vegetables cooked on the charcoal grill. The second offering is a sophisticated chef’s table with a special Omakase menu. This puts you in the hands of our Executive Chef as he creates and prepares a special menu every month. The third offering is our cocktail lounge and event space, So She Me. Whether it’s a lavish feast, cocktails with friends or an intimate gathering, this is the place to kick things into gear. Settle on our low-flung amber booths and peruse our extensive Japanese-inspired beverage selection. Sit back, and let the innovative, progressive beats of So She Me introduce you to new faces. You never know who you might rub shoulders with. Across all elements of Ora, the key focus of Executive Chef Nobuyuki Ura will be on freshness and seasonality. Ura says what separates Japanese cuisine from all others is that ‘it’s deceptively simple and designed to showcase prime produce, picked at the height of the season’. While Ura began his apprenticeship age 18 at Meguro Gajoen, a small luxury hotel in Tokyo, he has been in Australia since 1989, serving Japanese cuisine in his adopted home. He joined sushi e as executive chef in 2006 and took it to great heights as a hatted restaurant, praised by The Sydney Morning Herald’s food critics. ŌRA is a play on Aura and represents “the distinctive atmosphere or quality that seems to surround and be generated by a person, thing, or place”. With the interior by Kelly Ross, you’ll be able to move easily from a curated dining experience to late night high-jinks, with a sense of ease and pleasure. Showcasing the very best Australian produce, the menu at Ora sits alongside a beverage offering that includes seasonal cocktails; artisanal Sake from New-Gen makers and an international wine list, that includes some Japanese examples. STITCH COFFEE was born of an idea that coffee doesn’t need to be a standalone - it can be mixed together. We realised at an early stage that the art of blending coffee is the same as tailoring a piece of cloth. As a result, we stitched together origins with different flavours to bring forward the ultimate cup characteristics for everyone to enjoy. Daring, bold and unconventional, we aim to break the mould and bring specialty coffee to all. Sharing this craft and its fine coffee products is all for your enjoyment at home and beyond. We do this by creating connections with our suppliers and consumers from the very beginning of the coffee supply chain to the very end of the consumption process. With a focus on ensuring that consumers know about and have transparency about the entire coffee journey. We share information so that every participant in the coffee process succeeds, and our industry continues to thrive for decades to come. Innovation is one of our passions, bringing you coffee products that enable special moments shared over coffee. And we want this to happen anywhere and whenever, be it from our Broadway flagship store, in the comfort of your home or even when you are on the go! Bringing specialty coffee into every part of what we do starts with us ensuring that our wholesale customers (cafes and retailers) are knowledgeable through our coaching-style relationship. This helps to upskill them so that their offerings to you are of the highest level with a perfect cup of coffee, no matter the brewing method. We have become well known within our industry as a Specialty Coffee Roaster that is bold, fun and quality focused. We rotate single origins from all over the globe in an effort to bring variety and share knowledge with our consumers, as a platform to promote the work of coffee farmers across the continents. No favourites and no specialisation of region, but a focus on the farmer / producer – no matter where they were located. This is what makes up our community and feeds into our why, why we do what we do, why we exist. From pickers, farmers to roasters and coffee addicts, we are here to bring people together through coffee. “WE ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT CREATING UNIQUE, DELICIOUS COFFEE FROM AROUND THE WORLD AND TO CONNECT THESE WITH OUR CONSUMERS AS WE CELEBRATE THE WORK OF COFFEE PRODUCERS AND ALL THOSE ACROSS THE COFFEE JOURNEY. COFFEE TO US, IS A CRAFT ONLY POSSIBLE BY BRINGING COMMUNITIES TOGETHER.” OUR ORIGIN STORY At STITCH COFFEE we believe that coffee is much like a tapestry - it is a weaving of origins and flavours to create a delicious cup. Nawar Adra, owner and founder of STITCH COFFEE, had humble beginnings working as a barista in the iconic Western Sydney Suburbs cafe Circa Espresso. This is where Nawar started his roasting journey when Circa purchased their very own Probat P5 roaster for in-house production. During his time there, the focus was only on single origin coffees. However, Nawar gradually realised there was an artistry within the blending of origins. This merging of origins created a cup with distinct complexity, structure, and balance. The concept gave birth to STITCH COFFEE. We opened the doors to our roastery in 2015 and haven’t looked back. Today we are a company dedicated to creating connections through coffee, from green bean importers, to everyday coffee drinkers and everyone in between. Part of our offering goes beyond our coffee. It includes assisting cafes in up-skilling their baristas and teams, training them on extracting the perfect espresso and brew a delicious pour-over. Our love for coffee is fed by the daily home brewers and the cafes that serve our coffee, which is why education and knowledge sharing is so important for us. We will continue to source coffee ethically from around the world and ensure that we have the ability to communicate this with our community. We are continuously evolving our buying practises and fostering relationships with importers and farmers to ensure a healthy future for coffee. DIVERSITY & INCLUSIVITY It all starts with the heart of our company: our team. Our team members come from many countries and cultures, and that allows us to have a wide range of perspectives. Many points of view that come together and are stitched together into one big family. We believe in everyone’s potential to succeed by being a supportive workplace and setting our team up for success, just as we do with our business goals. SUSTAINABILITY & ETHICAL SOURCING STITCH COFFEE strive to forge a strong and long-lasting relationship with green bean importers who value sustainability as much as we do. We believe in empowering the entire supply chain in this industry and together make it better. Read more about our sustainability practices here. We are a highly visual brand, our packaging looks pretty nice (if we do say so ourselves) and we also want to be kind to our world. For the last few years we have endeavoured to move towards making our packaging recyclable and reduce waste all-round. We are proud to say we are good and clean for our planet, presenting new ways to package coffee that are different to other coffee products whilst maintaining the quality of the cup you brew COMMUNITY & COLLABORATION The coffee community is our why. From pickers, farmers to roasters and coffee addicts, we are here to bring people together through coffee. The ideology that we operate on is - If you want to go fast, go alone. If you want to go far, go together (African proverb). When one part of our community succeeds, we all do. We advocate on behalf of our fellow roasters to help them access great quality green beans. This is the power of co-roasting! Our co-roasting initiatives are powered by our sister BRAND ECRE. Find out more about it here. We support our wholesale customers with continuous training, connection to suppliers and business advice. We believe we only succeed when we stick together – or stitch together. GROWTH & EXPANSION We are bold, we are trailblazers, we thrive off being daring, unconventional and pushing boundaries. Both The Naked Duck and Little Duck offer breakfast & lunch with daily and seasonal specials according to market produce. Takeaway and catering are also available. Served in our garden-inspired setting, our high tea menu features a selection of tantalising treats that are as beautiful as they are delicious. Perfect for special celebrations or just because, our high tea is an experience you'll want to share with loved ones. Whether you're after a leisurely brunch, a decadent high tea or just a quiet spot to enjoy a cup of our signature coffee, Lil Miss Collins invites you to our little patch full of tasty treats and cosy vibes. Our Story We are a small family with 2 young kids. We migrated from UK to Australia and have called Sydney our home ever since. We have been welcomed with open arms by the community and believe we are in one of the best countries in the world! Having worked in the corporate world for a long time, the pandemic proved to be a pivotal moment as it allowed us time to reflect on the purpose of life, what we enjoy doing and how best we could serve the community. Being passionate about food, entertainment, helping others and having a corporate background made us believe that the hospitality industry is worth a shot, and we have not looked back since! EXPLORE NOW Our Venue We are big nature lovers and strongly believe being closer to nature is the way to attain Nirvana! Nature has been our inspiration for the café theme, and it is reflected in the rustic farmhouse vibe we have created for the café’. Everything else is aligned with it – the colorful floral ambiance, the music, the simplicity and freshness in our food, the diversity of our offerings & our focus on sustainability through reuse of recycled building materials. Our USP is undoubtedly the overall experience that we provide our customers when they visit us. It starts with a friendly service having a high level of empathy for our customers. Next is our food which is visually appealing yet healthy, fresh and flavourful. It this combination which really helps us stand out as most other venues struggle to get a tick in all the boxes. Our menu is diverse with over 30 items across a range of price points and also blends other cuisines. In addition, we do High Tea and offer a variety of hot and cold drinks including mocktails and cocktails which are not usually available in cafes. Last but not the least, it is the unique vibe! Ideally, we would like all our customers to leave the cafe having attained a state of Nirvana – complete bliss! Our focus is on touching all 5 senses through our food, drinks, service, music and the ambiance in a manner that delights our customers wanting them to not only come back again but also recommend us to their family and friends! EXPLORE NOW Our Flavours We believe in the adage that we are what we eat! Therefore, the basis of all our menu items has been simplicity, freshness & flavour. While the first two are important, the third is crucial for the palette! We blend the modern Australian cuisine with flavours inspired from Middle Eastern, Oriental and South Asian cuisines and therefore they also resonate well with the diverse communities here. Our creations go through multiple iterations with select customer groups, before we launch it to all our customers. Each of our creation is irresistibly chic with the right fusion of colors to create the picture-perfect moment. Our dishes are made with fresh, locally sourced ingredients that celebrate the best of Australian produce. Given we draw a lot of young people and families, providing a nutritious & balanced meal is a key focus in all our dishes. EXPLORE NOW Our Community The response from the local community since we opened doors till date has been overwhelmingly positive. This is testament to the fact that we have been in business for more than 8 years now! We are thankful for the love and support shown by the community but also their friends and families that visit us from all over Australia and the rest of the world when they are in Sydney! Our engagement with the local community is at multiple levels, from celebrating key occasions and festivals through special offers & dishes. Most recently we celebrated the tremendous performance at the Olympics by the Australian team by creating a special pancake in their honor. We also support other local businesses by promoting their products/services through our café outlets/ providing sponsorships/ gift vouchers. Our local community is our lifeblood. Needless to say, their love and support is crucial for our continued success and their constructive feedback helps us improve even further. EXPLORE NOW

brand story products stores partner recruitment English more information here→ brand story products stores partner recruitment English the inspiration of logo beginning originator renaming innovator new style tea by inspiration the inspiration of logo Inspired by the side-profile and simple lines seen on ancient coins, our classic logo was born by combining this aesthetic with the everyday gesture of taking a hearty sip of tea. beginning In 2011, a 20-year-old young man, frustrated by the lack of pure and great-tasting tea drinks on the market, decided to open a tea shop that served the kind of tea he loved. After over a year of preparation, he began thinking bigger: How can we make traditional tea cooler? Eventually, in his home kitchen, he developed a beta version of the first Cheese Tea — the salted cheese green tea. In May 2012, he opened the very first royaltea ( heytea’s predecessor ) in Jiangbianli, China. This marked the birthplace of the new style tea era. originator Before 2012, using cheap creamer powder, artificial flavors and coloring was the industry norm — almost no tea shops used natural ingredients. “You can’t make good milk tea without creamer powder,” many industry veterans claimed back then. Why not? Following our instincts, we chose a completely new path — using real tea, real milk, and natural ingredients to create the very first cheese tea. This cup of cheese tea rewrote industry history and marked the dawn of a new era in tea drinks. In the years that followed, starting from inspiration, we introduced a series of beloved products made with natural ingredients: Cloud Mango, Grape Boom, Supreme Brown Sugar Bobo Milk Tea, Mulberry Strawberry Boom, Kale Boost Tea, Cloud Coconut Blue... renaming Starting from a small alley, this cup of naturally crafted cheese tea quickly won customers’ hearts. Thanks to enthusiastic word-of-mouth recommendations, our stores began seeing spectacular lines. However, this popularity also attracted waves of counterfeiters. Copycat shops mushroomed nationwide, severely damaging our brand identity. To protect our brand, we made a decisive move: we completely rebranded from “royaltea” to the trademarked “HEYTEA”. This wasn’t just a name change — it was staying true to our roots while embarking on a new chapter. innovator Staying true to the original vision of our humble shop in Jiangbianli, China, we remain committed to natural ingredients and uncompromising quality. Driven by our own values, we strive to push the entire new style tea industry forward — toward a better future. We pledge full transparency and true quality in every handcrafted drink across all our stores. new style tea by inspiration Neither as stimulating as coffee nor as intoxicating as alcohol, we believe a good cup of tea has always had the power to bring calm and ease. From that little shop in Jiangbianli, China, we reimagined what tea could be in today’s world. With a desire to give new expression to this ancient Eastern tradition, we craft each cup with natural ingredients, offering a moment of quiet pleasure and mindful enjoyment in every sip. more information here→ brand story products stores partner recruitment English more information here→ brand story products stores partner recruitment English heytea heytea lab heytea teabar Tea Pavilion｜Infinitus Plaza Store, Hong Kong SAR, China On March 24, 2026, we opened another place to pause in the city at Infinitus Plaza, Hong Kong. With natural wood, textured stone, and greenery throughout, the space takes the form of a pavilion tea room. Inspired by the quiet atmosphere of a city park, it invites you to slow down for a moment whenever you pass by, and enjoy a cup of tea. Tea First｜Shamian DP Store, Guangzhou, China In our 11th year in Guangzhou, we finally arrived in Shamian. Located within Shamian Island’s century-old historic buildings, the space draws inspiration from Guangzhou’s morning tea culture. Bamboo weaving brings greenery indoors, creating a place to yum cha, relax, and enjoy tea the way locals have for generations. Tea Fossils｜Jing’an Joy City Store, Shanghai, China Inspired by archaeology, the store presents a future-facing tea culture site set in the year 3025. Bronze kettles, tea bowl fragments, and “tea fossils” reveal memories of old Shanghai tea stalls and hot-water houses. Visit the store and open the “Tea Fossil 3025 Archive” to discover tea-drinking clues from 2025. more information here→

brand story products stores partner recruitment English more information here→ brand story products stores partner recruitment English the inspiration of logo beginning originator renaming innovator new style tea by inspiration the inspiration of logo Inspired by the side-profile and simple lines seen on ancient coins, our classic logo was born by combining this aesthetic with the everyday gesture of taking a hearty sip of tea. beginning In 2011, a 20-year-old young man, frustrated by the lack of pure and great-tasting tea drinks on the market, decided to open a tea shop that served the kind of tea he loved. After over a year of preparation, he began thinking bigger: How can we make traditional tea cooler? Eventually, in his home kitchen, he developed a beta version of the first Cheese Tea — the salted cheese green tea. In May 2012, he opened the very first royaltea ( heytea’s predecessor ) in Jiangbianli, China. This marked the birthplace of the new style tea era. originator Before 2012, using cheap creamer powder, artificial flavors and coloring was the industry norm — almost no tea shops used natural ingredients. “You can’t make good milk tea without creamer powder,” many industry veterans claimed back then. Why not? Following our instincts, we chose a completely new path — using real tea, real milk, and natural ingredients to create the very first cheese tea. This cup of cheese tea rewrote industry history and marked the dawn of a new era in tea drinks. In the years that followed, starting from inspiration, we introduced a series of beloved products made with natural ingredients: Cloud Mango, Grape Boom, Supreme Brown Sugar Bobo Milk Tea, Mulberry Strawberry Boom, Kale Boost Tea, Cloud Coconut Blue... renaming Starting from a small alley, this cup of naturally crafted cheese tea quickly won customers’ hearts. Thanks to enthusiastic word-of-mouth recommendations, our stores began seeing spectacular lines. However, this popularity also attracted waves of counterfeiters. Copycat shops mushroomed nationwide, severely damaging our brand identity. To protect our brand, we made a decisive move: we completely rebranded from “royaltea” to the trademarked “HEYTEA”. This wasn’t just a name change — it was staying true to our roots while embarking on a new chapter. innovator Staying true to the original vision of our humble shop in Jiangbianli, China, we remain committed to natural ingredients and uncompromising quality. Driven by our own values, we strive to push the entire new style tea industry forward — toward a better future. We pledge full transparency and true quality in every handcrafted drink across all our stores. new style tea by inspiration Neither as stimulating as coffee nor as intoxicating as alcohol, we believe a good cup of tea has always had the power to bring calm and ease. From that little shop in Jiangbianli, China, we reimagined what tea could be in today’s world. With a desire to give new expression to this ancient Eastern tradition, we craft each cup with natural ingredients, offering a moment of quiet pleasure and mindful enjoyment in every sip. more information here→ brand story products stores partner recruitment English more information here→ brand story products stores partner recruitment English heytea heytea lab heytea teabar Tea Pavilion｜Infinitus Plaza Store, Hong Kong SAR, China On March 24, 2026, we opened another place to pause in the city at Infinitus Plaza, Hong Kong. With natural wood, textured stone, and greenery throughout, the space takes the form of a pavilion tea room. Inspired by the quiet atmosphere of a city park, it invites you to slow down for a moment whenever you pass by, and enjoy a cup of tea. Tea First｜Shamian DP Store, Guangzhou, China In our 11th year in Guangzhou, we finally arrived in Shamian. Located within Shamian Island’s century-old historic buildings, the space draws inspiration from Guangzhou’s morning tea culture. Bamboo weaving brings greenery indoors, creating a place to yum cha, relax, and enjoy tea the way locals have for generations. Tea Fossils｜Jing’an Joy City Store, Shanghai, China Inspired by archaeology, the store presents a future-facing tea culture site set in the year 3025. Bronze kettles, tea bowl fragments, and “tea fossils” reveal memories of old Shanghai tea stalls and hot-water houses. Visit the store and open the “Tea Fossil 3025 Archive” to discover tea-drinking clues from 2025. more information here→

text: Order now HOME INSTAGRAM CONTACT US Authentic Ramen & Tsukemen by Japanese Owner chef KOSUKE Ramen Honten House-made Noodle & Broth Order now Walk in Only(No BYO) KOSUKE Ramen To Our Valued Customers Today(010/07/2026), we would like to share an important announcement regarding our Rosebery and North Strathfield stores. To Our Rosebery Customers First of all, thank you so much for your incredible support over the past year. Although there is still a possibility that the Rosebery store may reopen in the future, I wanted to take this opportunity to express my sincere gratitude. Over the past year, many of you became regular customers, with some visiting three times a week, and even five days in a row. Despite our hidden location, you continued to support us, and on weekends many of you patiently waited in line. I truly cannot thank you enough. Since opening, we have constantly struggled to recruit staff. In recent months, however, applications have almost completely stopped. As the owner, I have been travelling between our North Strathfield and Rosebery stores, working around 98 hours a week, seven days a week, to keep both stores operating. With the opening(16/07/2026) of our new Melrose Park location, the shortage of experienced staff has become even more challenging. More importantly, I no longer feel confident that I can maintain the quality of our ramen and the level of service that our customers deserve across multiple locations. For this reason, making this decision has been one of the most difficult decisions I have ever had to make. To be completely transparent, another major factor was that I sponsored two chefs under business sponsorship visas because they wanted to build their future in Australia. Unfortunately, both resigned shortly after receiving their visas, which significantly disrupted our staffing plans. To Our North Strathfield Customers Thank you for supporting us over the past four years. Including our original Newington store, it has been an incredible eight-year journey. Many people may not know this, but I have never actively advertised or paid influencers to promote KOSUKE. I actually preferred to grow naturally. However, many well-known food influencers visited us on their own, and our popularity grew far beyond what I had expected. While I am deeply grateful for the support, it also brought criticism. Some people believed we became busy only because of social media, or that our ramen was not worth waiting two hours for. Those comments were difficult because I had never asked anyone to promote us in the first place. The decision to relocate from North Strathfield is based on several important reasons. Melrose Park is not far from our current North Strathfield location, allowing many of our existing customers to continue visiting us without having to travel much further. Parking has always been limited, making it inconvenient for customers, especially on rainy days. Our current kitchen no longer has the capacity for the ramen and new dishes that I want to create. The dining area is quite cramped, and I want to provide a more comfortable, relaxed experience. I would like to increase seating capacity slightly and allow customers to enjoy their meals without feeling rushed. Despite investing over AUD $20,000 in new air-conditioning systems, the restaurant still became uncomfortably hot during Sydney's hottest summer days. The new Melrose Park store allows us to solve all of these issues while creating a much better dining experience. Looking ForwardFor the time being, we will combine our North Strathfield and Rosebery operations into our new flagship store at Melrose Park Town Centre. Our goal is simple: To deliver the best ramen and the best service we have ever offered. Our soups have been upgraded, many new menu items have been added, and we truly believe this will become the best version of KOSUKE yet. If, in the future, we are fortunate enough to build a stronger team and find experienced staff who share our passion and standards, I sincerely hope to reopen our Rosebery store again. Until then, I hope to welcome you all to Melrose Park. Finally, for the first time since KOSUKE was founded, I will begin sharing more of our journey, new menu developments, and behind-the-scenes updates through our social media. Thank you again for supporting KOSUKE throughout this journey. I truly look forward to serving you again at Melrose Park Town Centre. P.S. There is a possibility that our Newington store may also close in the near future. We will share an update if and when a final decision has been made. The good news is that our Lane Cove store has an outstanding owner-chef and a very strong team, so it will continue operating as usual. Kosuke Founder, KOSUKE RAMEN Authentic Ramen & Tsukemen From Tokyo This is the authentic Japanese Ramen shop(Tokyo style) owned and ran by Japanese owner chef who has produced and owned many queueing ramen shops in Tokyo and Australia. Broths and noodles and most of the others (95% of foods) are all house made by owner chef(KOSUKE). House Made Noodle (自家製麺) We make two types of noodles that are "Thin(細麺)", and "Thick" (太麺). Thin noodle is made for our ramen by using two kinds of premium flours, natural sea salt, natural KANSUI(かん水) and filtered water with special way. It is very original because it has two aspects of "Hakata" and "Tokyo" noodle. When the noodle is firm, the texture is hard(バツッと) , but when it is soft, the texture is chewy(もちもち) . Not many ramen chefs in Japan can make this type of noodle without the long term experiences in Japan. Thick noodle(太麺) is made for our very popular "Tsukemen" and by using three kinds of premium flours(with a hint of whole grain flour), natural sea salt, natural KANSUI(かん水) and filtered water with special way. It has very good taste and flavour because of using whole grain flour. It is made to enjoy pleasantly sticky texture(もちもち) and the flour flavour. Pork Broth (豚骨スープ) Our pork broth (boiled&simmerd over 20hours) is not super thick to suit with majority of people, but still very rich, smooth and full of pork flavour. We use double more bones than typical ramen shops in order to give you the best pork flavour. This is possible because of owner chef(&wife) working together everyday and operating in the suburb(low rent) . Please come and try our authentic Japanese ramen. Also, we highly recommend our Tori-gara broth(Chicken) which is simmerd over 10 hours with pure water and tons of chickens. Also, it is good to know that our ramen is no added MSG. Tare(Sauce) -Shoyu/Shio- Our Shoyu(soy sauce) based tare is made by carefully selected 7 kinds of premium soy sauces, Premium Kombu(dried kelp), shiitake mushroom, niboshi(dried anchovy) and etc..from Japan. Our Shio(salt) based tare is also made by 6 kinds of premium natural salt of France, UK, Pakistan, Mongol and Japan, and with premium Kombu(dried kelp), shiitake mushroom, niboshi(dried anchovy) and etc...from Japan. text: Home Explore Destinations About Contact Add a Place View all 10 photos Home /Cafes /Australia /New South Wales /Eastwood 10000LAB Eastwood Cafe $1–20 4.1 (557) 90 Rowe St, Eastwood NSW 2122, Australia Write Review Save Share Directions Overview Full Menu Hours Location Reviews About This Place Nestled in the heart of Eastwood, 10000LAB Eastwood is a charming cafe and coffee shop that effortlessly blends the warmth of a bakery with the sophistication of a specialty coffee bar. Located at 90 Rowe St, this cozy spot invites patrons to unwind in an intimate setting filled with alluring aromas of freshly baked goods and expertly brewed coffee. The menu is a delightful exploration of textures and flavors, where sweet meets subtle in every bite. Signature treats such as the velvety Cheese Cake, the uniquely comforting Sweet Potato Cake, and the light but luscious Fresh Cream Cake showcase the cafe’s mastery in traditional and contemporary desserts. Not to be missed is their Korean-inspired Bingsoo with soft rice cake and sticky rice, a refreshing and indulgent cooling dessert that perfectly balances sweetness and chewiness. Fans of layered confection will appreciate the Green Tea Cake and the Tricolore, each slice a testament to the meticulous craftsmanship at play. Coffee lovers are well-catered to, with a variety of expertly prepared options such as the robust Long Black, the creamy Flat White, and the rich Mocha. Those seeking a chilled caffeine fix can indulge in several iced variants including the smooth Iced Long Black, the velvety Iced Matcha Latte, or the uniquely flavored Iced Taro Latte. For something a bit different, the Ade selections—Vinegar, Mojito Lime Ade, and Red Grapefruit Ade—offer refreshing, tangy alternatives to the traditional café lineup. Customers repeatedly praise the inviting ambiance of 10000LAB Eastwood. Dr Rahau Shirazi highlights the friendly staff and charming space, sharing a particular fondness for the matcha ice cream and black sesame latte paired with strawberry cake. Another guest, ma, raves about the freshly baked breads with their superb flavors and textures, noting the cozy dine-in area as perfect for relaxation. Fast service and tasty snacks like the pizza bread earn praise from F Liu, while J Fong commends the café’s fragrant, smooth coffee that makes for a perfect afternoon treat. Though some visitors like Seulki Chung mention the prices are on the higher side, the quality and deliciousness justify the indulgence. 10000LAB Eastwood is more than just a cafe; it is a destination that celebrates the artistry of coffee and the joy of baked indulgences. Whether you're popping in for a quick caffeine boost, settling down with a decadent slice of cake, or enjoying the unique Korean touches in their desserts and drinks, this café promises an authentically delightful experience that lingers long after the last sip and bite.
